Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 24: Yesh devarim shehen asurin beshabbat af al pi sheenam domin limlacha veenam meviin lide melacha. umippene ma neesru mishshum shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha asot chafatzecha beyom kadshi" veneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "vechibbadto measot derachecha mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar". lefichach asur leadam lehallech bachafatzav beshabbat vaafillu ledabber bahen kegon sheyyedabber im shuttafo ma yimkor lemachar o ma yikne o heach yivne bayit ze uvee ze sechora yelech lemakom peloni. kol ze vechayyotze bo asur shenneemar vedabber davar dibbur asur hirhur muttar:

Asur leadam lifkod ginnotav usedotav beshabbat kede lirot ma hen tzerichin o heach hen perotehen. shehare ze mehallech laasot cheftzo. vechen asur leadam sheyyetze beshabbat ad sof hattechum veyeshev sham ad shettechshach kede sheyyihye karov laasot chafatzav bemotzae shabbat. shehare nimtza hillucho beshabbat laasot chafatzav:

Bamme devarim amurim beshehechshich al hattechum laasot davar sheasur beshabbat laasoto. aval im hechshich laasot davar shemmuttar laasoto beshabbat hare ze muttar. ketzad. en machshichin al hattechum lehavi perot mechubbarin o liskor poalin. aval machshich hu lishmor perot shehare muttar lishmor beshabbat. umachshich lehavi behema o perot telushin. shehabbehema kore lah vehi baa af al pi shehi chutz lattechum. uferot telushin illu hayu sham mechitztzot haya muttar lahavian beshabbat. vechen omer adam lachavero lichrach peloni ani holech lemachar sheim hayu sham bureganim haya holech lesham beshabbat. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Muttar leadam lomar lefoel hannire shettaamod immi laerev. aval lo yomar lo heye nachon li laerev shennimtza ose cheftzo beshabbat. veasur larutz uledalleg beshabbat shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "measot derachecha" shello yehe hilluchecha shel shabbat kehilluchecha shel chol. veyored adam levor veshiach umeara afillu hen mea amma umetappes veyored veshote umetappes veole. veasur leharebot besicha betela shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "vedabber davar" shello yehe dibburecha shel shabbat kedibburecha shel chal:

Muttar larutz beshabbat lidvar mitzva kegon sheyyarutz levet hakkeneset o levet hammidrash. umechashshevin cheshbonot shel mitzva umoddin medida shel mitzva kegon mikve leda im yesh kashshiur o beged leda im mekabbel tuma. ufoskin tzedaka laaniyyim. veholchin levatte kenesiyyot ulevatte midrashot vaafillu letarteot uteraklin shel kutim lefakkeach al iske rabbim beshabbat. umeshaddechin al hattinoket leares veal hattinok lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ummanut. umevakkerin cholin umenachamim avelim. vehannichnas levakker et hachole omer shabbat hi millizok urefua kerova lavo. umachshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske kalla veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichin. veomer lo lech lemakom peloni lo matzata sham have mimmakom peloni lo matzata bemane have bematayim. uvilvad shello yizkor lo sechum mikkach. shekkol ellu vechayyotze bahen mitzva hen veneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "asot chafatzecha" vechulei chafatzecha asurin cheftze shamayim muttarin:

Mafligin bayyam haggadol beerev shabbat lidvar mitzva ufosek immo lishbot veeno shovet. umefirin nedarim beshabbat ben letzorech shabbat ben shello letzorech shabbat. venishalin lechacham al hannedarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat umattirin af al pi shehaya lahen penay lehattiran kodem hashshabbat sheddevarim ellu mitzva hen:

En onshin beshabbat af al pi shehaonesh mitzvat ase enah docha shabbat. ketzad. hare shennitchayyev bevet din malkot o mita en malkin oto veen memitin oto beshabbat shenneemar <small>(Shemot la 3)</small> "lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat" zo azhara levet din shello yisrefu beshabbat mi shennitchayyev serefa vehu haddin lishar onashin:

Muttar leadam lishmor perotav beshabbat ben telushim ben mechubbarin. veim ba adam littol mehen o behema vechayya leechol mehen goer bahen umakke bahem umarchikan. vahalo davar ze mechafatzav hu velamma hu muttar. mippene shello neesar ella lehakenot leatzmo chafatzim sheenan atta metzuyim o lehistakker uleharviach ulehittafel bahanaa shettavo leyado. aval lishmor mamono shekkevar ba leyado ad sheyyaamod kemot shehu muttar. ha lema ze dome lenoel beto mippene haggannavim:
Hameshammer zeraav mippene haofot umikshaav umidlaav mippene hachayya lo yesappek velo yerakked kederech sheose bechol gezera shemma yittol tzeror veyizrok arba ammot birshut harabbim:

Kol haddevarim shehen asurin mishshum shevut lo gazru alehen ben hashshemashot ella beatzmo shel yom hu shehen asurin aval ben hashshemashot muttarin. vehu sheyyihye sham devar mitzva o dochak. ketzad. muttar lo ben hashshemashot laalot bailan o lashut al pene hammayim lehavi lulav o shofar. vechen morid min hailan o motzi min hakkarmelit eruv sheasa. vechen im haya tarud venechpaz venitzrach ledavar shehu mishshum shevut ben hashshemashot hare ze muttar. aval im lo haya sham dochak velo devar mitzva asur. lefichach en measserin et havvadday ben hashshemashot af al pi sheissur haferashat hammaaser beshabbat mishshum shevut. aval measserim et haddemay:
Katan sheasa beshabbat davar shehu mishshum shevut kegon shettalash meatzitz sheeno nakuv o tiltel becharmelit en bet din metzuvvin lehaferisho. vechen im hinnicho aviv en memachin beyado:

Asru chachamim letaltel miktzat devarim beshabbat kederech shehu ose bechol. umippene ma nagu beissur ze. amru uma im hizhiru neviim vetziuu shello yihye hilluchecha beshabbat kehilluchecha bechol velo sichat hashshabbat kesichat hchol shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "vedabber davar" kal vachomer shello yihye tiltul beshabbat ketiltul bechol kede shello yihye keyom chol beenav veyavo lehagebiah uletakken kelim mippinna lefinna o mibbayit levayit o lehatzenia avanim vechayyotze bahen shehare hu batel veyoshev beveto vivakkesh davar sheyyitassek bo venimtza shello shavat uvittel hattaam shenneemar betora <small>(Shemot 22 12)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 13)</small> "lemaan yanuach":

Veod kesheyyevakker vitaltel kelim shemmelachtan leissur efshar sheyyitassek bahen meat veyavo lide melacha. veod mippene shemmiktzat haam enam baale ummanuyyot ella betelin kol yemehen kegon hattayyalin veyoshve keranot shekkol yemehen hen shovtim mimmelacha veim yihye muttar lehallech uledabber uletaltel kishar hayyamim nimtza shello shavat shevita hannikkeret. lefichach shevita middevarim ellu hi shevita hashshava bechol adam. umippene devarim ellu nagu beissur hattiltul. veasru shello yetaltel adam beshabbat ella kelim hatztzarich lahem kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 25: Yesh keli shemmelachto lehetter vehu hakkeli shemmuttar laasot bo beshabbat davar shennaasa lo bechol. kegon kos lishtot bo ukeara leechol bah vesakkin lachtoch bo basar ufat vekurnas liftzoa bo egozim vechayyotze bahen:
Veyesh keli shemmelachto leissur vehu hakkeli sheasur laasot bo beshabbat davar shennaasa bo. kegon machteshet verechayim vechayyotze bahen sheasur lichtosh velitchon beshabbat:

Kol keli shemmelachto lehetter ben haya shel etz o shel cheres o shel even o shel mattechet muttar letaltelo beshabbat. ben bishvil atzmo shel keli ben letzorech mekomo ben letzorech gufo. vechol keli shemmelachto leissur ben haya shel etz o shel cheres o shel avanim o shel mattechet muttar letaltelo beshabbat ben letzorech gufo ben letzorech mekomo aval bishvil atzmo shel keli asur:

Ketzad. metaltel hu et hakkeara shel etz leechol bah o leshev bimkomah. o kede shello tigganev. veze hu bishvil atzmah. vechen im tiltel otah min hachamma kede shello tityabbesh vetishshaver o min haggeshamim kede shello titpach vetippased hare ze metaltel bishvil atzmah umuttar mippene shemmelachtah lehetter:

Vechen metaltel hu harechayim o hammachteshet leshabber aleha egozim o laalot aleha lammitta veze hu letzorech gufo o leshev bimkomo. aval eno metaltelah kede shello tishshaver velo kede shello tigganev. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Vechol sheeno keli kegon avanim umaot vekanim vekorot vechayyotze bahen asur letaltelan. even gedola o kora gedola af al pi shehi nittelet baasara bene adam im yesh torat keli aleha metaltelim otah. daltot habbayit af al pi shehen kelim lo huchenu letaltel lefichach im nitparku afillu beshabbat en metaltelin otan. vechen heafar vehachol vehammet en mezizin otan mimmekoman. uven shemona chay hare hu keeven veasur letaltelo:

Muttar letaltel hakkeli afillu shello letzorech tashmisho ella laasot bo melacha shello naasa letashmishah. ketzad. notel adam kurnas liftzoa bo egozim. kordom lachtoch bo devela. megera legarer bah et haggevina. magrefa ligrof bah et haggerogarot. et harachat veet hammazleg latet alav ochel lekatan. et hakkosh veet hakkarkar litchov bo. machat shel sakkain liftoach bo et haddelet. et hammachteshet leshev aleha. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Umetaltel adam machat shel yad hashshelema littol bah et hakkotz. aval im nittal hakkatze hannakuv shellah o hakkatze hachad shellah en metaltelin otah. veim hayta golem vaadayin lo nikkeva muttar letaltelah:

Kol keli shemmakpid alav shemma yifchatu damav kegon kelim hammuktzim lischora vechelim hayekarim beyoter shemmakpid alehen shemma yippasdu asur letaltelan beshabbat veze hu hannikra muktze mechamat chesron kis. kegon hammassar haggadol veyated shel machresha vesakkin shel tabbachim vecherev shel ushekafim vechitztzin hacharashim vekurnas shel bassamim vechayyotze bahen:

Kol keli shehuktza mechamat haissur asur letaltelo. kegon ner shehidliku bo beshabbat vehammenora shehaya hanner aleha veshulchan shehayu alav maot af al pi shekkava hanner o shennaflu hammaot asur letaltelan. shekkol keli shehaya asur letaltelo ben hashshemashot neesar letaltelo kol hashshabbat kullah af al pi shehalach haddavar sheggaram lo haissur:
Aval keli hammuktze mechamat meuso kegon ner yashan shel neft ucheli hatztzoa vechayyotze bahen muttar letaltelan beshabbat im hutzrach lahen:

Kol hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat shennitparku daltotehen kegon daltot shidda teva umigdal ben shennitparku beshabbat ben shennitparku kodem hashshabbat muttar letaltel otan delatot. vechen kol hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat shennishberu ben kodem hashshabbat ben beshabbat shivrehen nittalin vehu sheyyihyu shivrehen osin meen melachtan. ketzad. shivre areva lechassot bahen et pi hechavit. shivre zechuchit lechassot bahen et pi happach. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval im en hashshevarim reuyin limlacha kelal asur letaltelan:

Kol kissuye hakkelim nittalim beshabbat vehu sheyyesh torat keli alehen. haya keli mechubbar bakkarka kegon chavit hattemuna baaretz. im yesh bakkissuy shellah bet achiza metaltelin oto veim lav en metaltelin oto. vechen kissuye hakkarkaot kegon borot vacharitzin en metaltelin kissuy shellahen ella im ken yesh lo bet achiza. kissuy hattannur af al pi sheen lo bet achiza muttar letaltelo:

Shene devarim echad asur letaltelo veechad muttar letaltelo vehen semuchim ze laze o ze al ze o ze baze uvizman shemmetaltelin echad mehen yetaltel hashsheni. im haya tzarich laddavar shemmuttar letaltelo metaltelo veaf al pi sheddavar haasur mittaltel immo. veim tzarich letaltel davar haasur lo yetaltelennu beoto davar hammuttar:

Ketzad. pagga shehayta temuna beteven vacharara shehayta al gabbe gechalim tochavan bechosh o becharkar venotlan veaf al pi shehatteven vehaggechalim ninarim beshabbat bishat netila. vechen lefet o tzenonot shehayu temunim beafar umiktzat healim megullim shomtan beshabbat beale shellahen veaf al pi sheheafar ninar. aval im haya kikkar o tinok al gabbe haeven o al gabbe hakkora lo yetaltel haeven o hakkora bakkikkar o battinok sheyyesh aleha. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Notel adam et beno sheyyesh lo gaguin alav vehaeven beyado aval lo dinar sheim yippol haddinar yittelennu haav beyado. kalkala shehayta nekuva vesatam nekev shellah beeven muttar letaltelah shehare haeven naaset kedofen. hayta hakkalkala melea perot vehaeven betoch happerot im hayu happerot retubbim kegon anavim vetutim notel otah kemot shehi sheim yenaer happerot yittanfu beafar uvimkom hefsed lo gazru:

Chavit sheshshachach even al piha mattah al tziddah vehi nofelet. hayta ben hechaviyyot vehaeven aleha magbihah lemakom acher umatte al tziddah sham vehaeven nofelet. vechen hashshocheach maot al hakkar vetzarach lakkar noer et hakkar vehen noflot. veim tzarich limkom hakkar notel et hakkar vehammaot alav. aval im hinniach hammaot meerev shabbat al hakkar o hinniach haeven al pi hechavit hare ellu asurin letaltelan vaafillu nittelu hammaot vehaeven shehare naasu basis ledavar haasur:
Haeven shebbakkeruya im memallein bah veenah nofelet hare hi kemiktzat hakkeruya umuttar lemalleot bah veim lav en memallein bah. beged sheal hakkane shomto meal hakkane:

Perot sheasur leechol kegon perot sheenam meessarin afillu hen chayyavin bemaaser middivrehem o maaser rishon shello nittela terumato o teruma temea o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kehilchatan asur letaltelan. aval haddemay hoil verauy laaniyyim vechen maaser sheni vehekdesh sheppedaan af al pi shello natan hachomesh muttar letaltelan:

Metaltel yisrael hatteruma af al pi sheenah reuya lo. umetaltelin teruma temea im hattehora o im hachullin im hayu shenehem bichli echad. bamme devarim amurim beshehayta hattehora lematta vehayu perot hammittannefin bakkarka sheim yenaer otan yippasdu. aval im hayu egozim ushekedim vechayyotze bahen noer hakkeli venotel hattehora o hachullin umanniach hattuma. veim haya tzarich limkom hakkeli ben shehattehora lemala ben shehayta lematta metaltel hakkol keechad:

Nidbach shel avanim shechashav alav mibbeod yom im limdum muttar leshev alehen lemachar veim lav asur. charayot shel dekel sheggedaran leetzim venimlach alehen meerev shabbat lishiva muttar letaltelan. vechen im yashav alehen mibbeod yom muttar letaltelan:

Hakkash sheal hammitta lo yenaneennu beyado aval menaneo begufo. veim hu maachal behema muttar letaltelo. vechen im haya alav kar o sadin vechayyotze bahen menaneo beyado shehare naasa kemi sheyyashav alav mibbeod yom. hammachnis kuppa shel afar beveto im yiched lah keren zavit meerev shabbat metaltelo beshabbat veose bo kol tzerachav:

Asur levattel keli mehechano mippene shehu kesoter. ketzad. lo yitten keli tachat hanner beshabbat lekabbel et hashshemen hannotef. shehashshemen shebbanner asur letaltelo uchesheyyippol lakkeli yeaser tiltul hakkeli shehaya muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefichach en notnin keli tachat hattarnegolet lekabbel betzatah. aval kofe hu hakkeli aleha. vechen kofe hakkeli al kol davar sheasur letaltelo shehare lo bittelo sheim yachpotz yittelennu:

Notnin keli tachat haddelef veim nitmalle hakkeli shofech veshone veeno nimna. vehu sheyyihye haddelef rauy lirchitza aval im eno rauy en notnin veim natan muttar letaltelo bammayim hammeusin shebbo. sheen osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla:

Chavit shel tevel shennishbera mevi keli umanniach tachteha hoil veim avar vetikkeno metukkan hare hu kimtukkan. venotnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot mippene sheen bahen mammash umuttar letaltel hakkeli. kora shennishbera en somchin otah besafsal o baarukkot hammitta ella im ken hayu revachim vechol zeman sheyyachpotz yitlem kede shello yevattel keli mehechano. porsin machtzelet al gabbe avanim beshabbat o al gabbe kavveret devorim bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud shehare notlah bechol et sheyyirtze. vechofin et hassal beshabbat lifne haefrochim bishvil sheyyaalu alav veyerdu shehare muttar letaltelo kesheyyerdu mealav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Behema shennafla levor o leammat hammayim im yachol litten lah parnasa bimkomah mefarnesin otah ad motzae shabbat veim lav mevi karim uchesatot umanniach tachteha veim alta alta. veaf al pi shemmevattel keli mehechano shehare mashlicho labbor letoch hammayim mippene tzaar baale chayyim lo gazru. veasur lehaalotah beyado. vechen en okrin behema vechayya veof bechatzer aval dochin otan ad sheyyikkansu. umedaddin agalim useyachim. tarnegolet shebbarcha en medaddin otan mippene shehi nishmetet min hayyad venimtzeu agappeha nitlashin aval dochin otah ad shettikkanes:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 26:
Kol kele haoreg vachavalav vekanim shello muttar letaltelan kichli shemmelachto leissur chutz mikkoved haelyon vechoved hattachton lefi sheen nittalin mippene shehen tekuin. vechen haammudim shel oreg asur letaltelan shemma yetakken haggummot shellahen. ushear kele haoreg muttarin: 
Michbadot shel temara vechayyotze bahen shemmechabbedin bahen et hakkarka hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter shehare muttar lechabbed beshabbat. levenim shennisharu min habbinyan hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter mippene sheruyin lehasev alehen shehare shafin otan umetakkenin otan. veim tzavar otan hare hiktzam veasur letaltelam: 
Cheres ketanna muttar letaltelah afillu birshut harabbim hoil ureuya hi bechatzer lechassot bah pi keli katan. megufat chavit shennitkatta hi ushevareha muttar letaltelah veim zerakah laashpa mibbeod yom asur letaltelah. keli shennitroea lo yitlosh mimmennu cheres lechassot bo o lismoch bo: 
Muttar lehachenis levet hakkisse shalosh avanim mekurzalot lekanneach bahen vechamma shiuran kimlo hayyad. aval adama shehi kerova lehitparech asur letaltelah lekanneach bah. umuttar lehaalot avanim laggag lekanneach bahen. yardu alehen geshamim venishtaku betit im rishshuman nikkar muttar letaltel. even sheyyesh aleha tinnuf shevvadday lekanneach hi muttar letaltelah vaafillu hi gedola: 
Haya lefanav tzeror vecheres mekanneach batztzeror veim haya hacheres meogne kelim mekanneach bacheres. hayu lefanav tzeror vaasavim im hayu asavim rakkim mekanneach bahen veim lav mekanneach batztzeror: 
Sheyare machtzelaot shebbalu hare hen kichli shemmelachto lehetter mippene sheruyin lechassot bahen hattinnuf. aval sheyare begadim shebbalu sheen bahen shelosha al shelosha asur letaltelan sheenan reuyin lo laaniyyim velo laashirim. shivre hattannur muttar letaltelan vahare hen kechol hakkelim shemmelachtan lehetter. kira shennishmeta achat miyyarchoteha asur letaltelah shemma yitka: 
Sullam shel aliyya asur letaltelo sheen alav torat keli. veshel shovach muttar lehattoto. aval lo yolicho mishshovach leshovach shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol veyavo latzud. kane shemmoskin bo hazzetim im yesh alav torat keli hare hu kichli shemmelachto leissur. kane shehitkino baal habbayit lihyot poteach venoel bo im yesh torat keli alav hare hu kichli shemmelachto lehetter: 
Delet shehaya lah tzir af al pi sheen lah atta tzir shehechinah listom bah makom muktze vehi nigreret shennotlin otah vesotmin bah. vechen chadakim shessotmin bahen happirtza. vechen machtzelet hannigreret. bizman shekkeshurin uteluyin bakkotel sotmin bahen venoalim bahem veim lav en noalin bahen. veim hayu gevohim meal haaretz noalin bahen: 
Delet shehaya lah luach echad sheshshomtin otah venoalin bah im lo haya lah lematta ken kemo askuppa shemmochiach aleha shehi keli muchan linila en noalin bah. veim yesh lematta askuppa noalim bah. vechen neger sheyyesh berosho kelustera shemmochachat alav shehu keli muchan linila veeno kora kishar kol hakkorot noalin bo beshabbat: 
Neger sheen berosho kelustera im haya kashur vetaluy baddelet noalin bo. vechen im haya nittal veegdo immo. aval im haya egdo kavua baddelet vehaya hanneger nishmat kemo kora umannichin oto bazzavit vechozrin venoalin bo beet sherotzin hare ze asur linol bo sheen alav torat keli veeno agud veen bo eged lehochiach alav: 
Menora shel chulyot ben gedola ben ketanna en metaltelin otah shemma yachazirenah beshabbat. hayu bah chadakim vehi niret kevaalat chulyot. im hayta gedola hannittelet bishte yadayim asur letaltelah mippene kavdah. hayta ketanna mizzo muttar letaltelah: 
Minal sheal gabbe haimmum shomtin oto beshabbat. machbesh shel baale battim mattirin aval lo kovshin. veshel kovsin lo yigga bo mippene shehu muktze mechamat chesron kis. vechen gizze tzemer en metaltelin otan mippene shehu makpid alehen. lefichach im yichadan letashmish muttarin. vehashshelachin muttar letaltelan ben shehayu shel baal habbayit o shel umman mippene sheeno makpid alehem: 
Kol davar metunnaf kegon rei veki vetzoa vechayyotze bahen im hayu bechatzer sheyyoshvin bah muttar lehotzian leashpa o levet hakkisse veze hu hannikra geraf shel rei. veim hayu bechatzer acheret kofin alehen keli kede shello yetze hakkatan veyitlachlech bahen. rok sheal hakkarka dorso lefi tummo veholech. metaltelin kenuna mippene efro af al pi sheyyesh alav shivre etzim mippene shehu kigraf shel rei. veen osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla beshabbat. aval im naasa meelav o sheavar veasahu motziin oto: 
Shemen sheyyotze mittachat hakkora shel bet habbad beshabbat vechen temarim ushekedim hammuchanim lischora muttar leachlam beshabbat. vaafillu otzar shel tevua o tevua tzevura matchil lehistappek mimmenna beshabbat sheen shum ochel shehu muktze beshabbat kelal ella hakkol muchan hu. chutz miggerogarot vetzimmukin shebbammuktze bizman shemmeyabbeshim otam hoil umasrichot bentayim veenam reuyin laachila hare hen asurin beshabbat mishshum muktze. chavit shennitgalleta vaavattiach shennishbera af al pi sheenan reuyin laachila notlan umannichan bemakom hammutzna. kayyotze bo kamea sheeno mumche af al pi sheen yotzin bo metaltelin oto. motar hashshemen shebbanner veshebbakkeara shehidliku bahen beotah shabbat asur lehistappek mimmennu beotah shabbat mippene shehu muktze mechamat issur: 
Otzar shel tevua o shel kadde yayin af al pi shemmuttar lehistappek mimmennu asur lehatechil bo lefannoto ella lidvar mitzva kegon sheppinnahu lehachenasat orchin o likboa bo bet hammidrash vechetzad mefannin oto. kol echad veechad memalle arba o chamesh kuppot ad sheggomrin. velo yechabbedu karkaito shel otzar kemo shebbearnu ella nichnas veyotze bo veose shevil beraglav bichnisato uvitziato: 
Kol shehu rauy lemaachal behema vechayya veof hammetzuyin metaltelin oto beshabbat. ketzad. metaltelin et hatturmos hayyavesh mippene shehu maachol leizzim aval lo et hallach. et hechatzav mippene shehu maachol litzvaim. et hachardal mippene shehu maachol leyonim. et haatzamot mippene shehen maachol lichlavim. vechen kol hakkelippin vehaggarinin haruyin lemaachal behema metaltelin otan. vesheenan reuyin ochel et haochel vezorkan leacharav veasur letaltelan. metaltelin basar tafuach mippene shehu maachol lechayya. umetaltelin basar chay ben tafel ben maliach mippene sherauy leadam. vechen dag maliach. aval hattafel asur letaltelo: 
En metaltelin shivre zechuchit af al pi shehen maachol lenaamiyyot. velo chavile zemorot af al pi shehen maachol lefilim. velo et halluf af al pi shehen maachol leorvim. mippene sheen ellu vechayyotze bahen metzuyin etzel rov bene adam: 
Chavile kash vachavile zeradin im hitkinan lemaachal behema metaltelin otan veim lav en metaltelin otan. chavile sea pua veezov vekoranit. hichnisan leetzim en mistappek mehem beshabbat. lemaachal behema mistappek mehen. vechen baaminta vechen befegam vechen bishar mine tavlin: 
En gorfin maachol millifne happetam ben beevus shel keli ben beevus shel karka. veen mesallekin latztzedadin mippene hari gezera shemma yashve gummot. notlin millifne hachamor venotnin lifne hashshor. aval en notlin millifne hashshor venotnin lifne hachamor mippene shehammaachol shellifne hashshor metunnaf beriro veen rauy lemaachal behema acheret. vechen alim sherecham ra umeusin veen habbehema ochaltan asur letaltelan. lefichach telay shel dagim asur letaltelo veshel basar muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Af al pi sheasur letaltel et hammet beshabbat sachin oto umedichin oto uvilvad shello yazizu bo evar. veshomtin et hakkar mittachtav kede sheyyihye muttal al hachol bishvil sheyyamtin velo yasriach. umeviin kele meker uchele mattachot umannichin lo al kereso kede shello yitpach. ufokkin et nekavav shello yikkanes bahen haruach. vekoshrin et hallechi lo sheyyaale ella shello yosif. veen meammetzin et enav beshabbat: 
Met hammuttal bachamma manniach alav kikkar o tinok umetaltelo. vechen im nafla deleka bechatzer sheyyesh bah met manniach alav kikkar o tinok umetaltelo. veim en sham kikkar velo tinok matztzilin oto min haddeleka mikkol makom shemma yavo lechabbot mippene shehu bahul al meto shello yissaref. velo hittiru letaltel bechikkar o tinok ella lemet bilvad mippene sheadam bahul al meto: 
Haya muttal bachamma veen lahem makom letaltelo o shello ratzu lahazizo mimmekomo bain shene bene adam veyoshvim mishshene tzedadav. cham lahem millematta ze mevi mittato veyoshev aleha veze mevi mittato veyoshev aleha. cham lahem millemala ze mevi machtzelet uforesh al gabbav. veze mevi machtzelet uforesh al gabbav. ze zokef mittato venishmat veholech lo veze zokef mittato venishmat veholech lo venimtza mechitztza asuya meeleha. shehare machtzelet ze umachtzelet ze gaggehen semuchot zo lazo ushene ketzotehem al hakkarka mishni tzidde hammet: 
Met shehisriach bevayit venimtza mitbazze ben hachayyim vehem mitbazzim mimmennu muttar lehotzio lecharmelit. gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora shehu <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "lo tasur min haddavar asher yaggidu lecha yamin usemol". veim haya lahen makom acher latzet bo en motziin oto ella menichin oto bimkomo veyotzin hem:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 27: Hayyotze chutz litchum hammedina beshabbat loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 16 29)</small> "al yetze ish mimmekomo bayyom hashshevii". makom ze hu techum hair. velo natna tora shiur litchum ze aval chachamim hetiku shettechum ze hu chutz lishnem asar mil keneged machane yisrael. vechach amar lahem moshe rabbenu lo tetzu chutz lammachane. umiddivre sofrim shello yetze adam chutz lair ella ad alpayim amma aval chutz lealpayim amma asur. shealpayim amma hu migrash hair:

Nimtzeta lamed shemmuttar leadam beshabbat lehallech et kol hair kullah afillu hayta keninve. ben shehayta mukkefet choma ben shello hayta mukkefet choma. vechen muttar lo lehallech chutz lair alpayim amma lechol ruach merubbaot ketavla merubbaat kede sheyyihye niskar et hazzaviyyot. veim yatza chutz lealpayim amma makkin oto makkat mardut ad shenem asar mil. aval im yatza vehirchik min hair yeter al shenem asar mil afillu amma achat loke min hattora:

Hamehallech chutz lattechum lemala measara tefachim kegon shekkafatz al gabbe ammudim sheggevohin asara veen bechol echad mehen arbaa al arbaa tefachim hare ze safek im yesh techumin lemala measara o en techumin lemala measara. aval im halach al makom sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa hare ze kimhallech al haaretz veyesh issur techumin sham:

Mi sheshshavat bedir shebbammidbar o besahar o bimara vechayyotze bahen mershut hayyachid mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechol ruach beribbua. vechen hashshovet bevika afillu haya yashen beshaa shennichnas hashshabbat shello kana shevita yesh lo lehallech mimmekomo alpayim amma lechol ruach beribbua. haya mehallech bevika veeno yodea techum shabbat mehallech alpayim pesiot benoniyyot veze hu techum shabbat:

Hamehallech alpayim amma sheyyesh lo lehallech veshalma middato betoch dir o sahar o meara o betoch hammedina eno mehallech ella ad sof middato. veen omrin hoil vechilleta middato betoch reshut hayyachid mehallech et kullah. bamme devarim amurim beshekkalta middato bemiktzat hair o bemiktzat hammeara aval im hayta otah reshut hayyachid muvlaat betoch alpayim amma shello techashev lo kol otah harshut kearba ammot umashlimin lo et hashshear:

Ketzad. hare shehaya elef amma mimmekom shevitato im michutz lair ad medina o meara sheyyesh bearkah elef amma o pachot meelef mehallech et kol hammedina o hammeara sheppaga bah umehallech chutza lah elef amma pachot arba ammot:
Aval im haya bammedina o bammeara sheppaga bah betoch middato elef amma veamma eno mehallech bah ella elef amma bilvad shehu tashlum alpayim amma sheyyesh lo:

Mi shekkalta middato bachatzi hair af al pi sheeno mehallech ella ad sof middato muttar letaltel bechol hair al yede zerika. vechen mi sheshshavat bevika vehikkifuhu nachrim mechitztza beshabbat eno mehallech bah ella alpayim amma lechol ruach af al pi shehu betoch hammechitztza. umuttar lo letaltel bechol hammechitztza al yede zerika im hikkifuha leshem dira:

Mi shehaya ba badderech likkanes limdina ben shehaya ba bayyam ben shehaya ba becharava. im nichnas betoch alpayim amma karov lair kodem sheyyikkanes hashshabbat af al pi shello higgia lammedina ella beshabbat hare ze yikkanes vihallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechol ruach:

Haya ba limdina veyashen badderech velo neor ella beshabbat ucheshenneor matza atzmo betoch hattechum hare ze yikkanes lah vihallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma lechol ruach. mippene sheddato hayta lehallech limdina zo ulefichach kana shevita im bene hammedina kemotan shehare nichnas immahen battechum:

Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum afillu amma achat lo yikkanes shehaarba ammot sheyyesh lo laadam techillatan mimmakom shehu omed bo. lefichach kevan sheyyatza chutz mittechumo amma o yeter yeshev bimkomo veen lo lehallech ella betoch arba ammot meamidat raglav velachutz. vechen mi shehechshich chutz litchum hammedina afillu amma achat hare ze lo yikkanes lah ella mehallech mimmakom shennichnas alav hashshabbat vehu omed bo alpayim amma bilvad. veim kalta middato bemiktzat hair mehallech ad sof middato kemo sheamarnu. hayta raglo achat betoch hattechum veraglo achat chutz lattechum hare ze yikkanes:

Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum shello ledato kegon shehotziuhu nachrim o ruach raa o sheshshagag veyatza en lo ella arba ammot. chazar ledaat en lo ella arba ammot. hechziruhu keillu lo yatza. veim netanuhu birshut hayyachid kegon shennetanuhu nachrim baddir vesahar umeara o beir acheret yesh lo lehallech et kullah. vechen im yatza leechad meellu bishgaga venizkar vehu betochan mehallech et kullah:

Yatza chutz lattechum ledaat af al pi shechazar shello ledaat kegon shehechziruhu nachrim o ruach raa en lo ella arba ammot. vechen im yatza chutz lattechum ledaat af al pi shehu betoch reshut hayyachid kegon dir vesahar en lo ella arba ammot. hammefaresh bayyam haggadol af al pi shehu chutz lattechum sheshshavat bo mehallech et kol hassefina kullah umetaltel bechullah:

Mi sheyyatza chutz lattechum shello ledaat vehukkaf bimchitztza beshabbat yesh lo lehallech kol otah hammechitztza vehu shello tihye yeter al alpayim amma. veim haya techum sheyyatza mimmennu muvla miktzato betoch hammechitztza shennaaset shello ledato hoil veyesh lo lehallech et kol hammechitztza hare ze nichnas litchumo vechevan sheyyikkanes hare hu keillu lo yatza:

Kol mi sheen lo lazuz mimmekomo ella betoch arba ammot im nitzrach linkavav hare ze yotze umarchik venifne vechozer limkomo. veim nichnas lemiktzat techum sheyyatza mimmennu beet sheyyitrachek lehippanot hoil venichnas yikkanes ucheillu lo yatza. vehu shello yatza battechilla ledaat aval im yatza ledaat af al pi shennichnas en lo ella arba ammot:

Kol mi sheyyatza birshut bet din kegon haedim shebbau lehaid al reiyyat hallevana vechayyotze bahen mimmi shemmuttar lo latzet lidvar mitzva yesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach beoto makom shehiggia lo. veim higgia limdina hare hu keanshe hair veyesh lo alpayim amma lechol ruach chutz lammedina:

Haya yotze birshut veamru lo vehu holech badderech kevar naaset hammitzva sheyyatzata laasot yesh lo mimmekomo alpayim amma lechol ruach. veim haya miktzat techum sheyyatza mimmennu birshut muvla betoch alpayim amma sheyyesh lo mimmekomo hare ze chozer limkomo ucheillu lo yatza. vkol hayyotzin lehatztzil nafshot yisrael miyyad ovde kochavim umazzalot o min hannahar o min hammappolet yesh lahem alpayim amma lechol ruach mimmakom shehitztzilu bo. veim hayta yad haovde kochavim umazzalot takkifa vehayu mefachadim lishbot bammakom shehitztzilu bo hare ellu chozrin beshabbat limkoman uvichle zenan:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 28:
Kol bet dira shehu yotze min hammedina im haya beno uven hammedina shivim amma ushene shelishe amma shehu tzela bet satayim hamerubbaat o pachot mizze hare ze mitztaref limdina venechshav mimmenna. ucheshemmoddin lah alpayim amma lechol ruach moddin chutz mibbet dira ze: 
Haya bayit ze karov lammedina beshivim amma uvayit sheni karov levayit rishon beshivim amma uvayit shelishi karov lashsheni beshivim amma vechen ad mahalach kamma yamim hare hakkol kimdina achat ucheshemmoddin moddin michutz labbayit haacharon. vehu sheyyihye bet dira ze arba ammot al arba ammot o yeter: 
Vechen bet hakkeneset sheyyesh bo bet dira lechazzanin uvet avodat kochavim umazzalot sheyyesh bo bet dira lechohanehem vehaotzarot sheyyesh bahen bet dira vehaggesher vehakkever sheyyesh bahen bet dira veshalosh mechitztzot sheen aleha tikra veyesh bahen arba al arba ammot vehabburganin vehabbayit habbanuy bayyam ushete mechitztzot sheyyesh alehen tikra umeara sheyyesh binyan al piha veyesh bah bet dira. kol ellu mitztarfin immah im hayu betoch shivim amma veshirayim. umeoto habbayit hayyotze roin keillu chut matuach al pene kol hammedina umoddin chutz leoto hachut alpayim amma: 
Veellu sheen mitztarfin immah. shete mechitztzot sheen alehen tikra af al pi sheddarin benehen. vehaggesher vehakkever uvet hakkeneset uvet avodat kochavim umazzalot vehaotzarot sheen bahen bet dira vehabbor vehashshiach vehammeara vehashshovach uvayit shebbassefina kol ellu vechayyotze bahen en mitztarfin immah: 
Hayu shete ayarot zo semucha lazo im yesh benehen mea vearbaim veachat ushelish kede sheyyihye shivim amma veshirayim lazo veshivim amma veshirayim lazo choshvin shetehen keir achat venimtzet kol ir mehen mehallechet et kol hair hashsheniyya vachutza lah alpayim amma. hayu shelosha kefarim meshullashin im yesh ben haemtzai uven kol echad veechad min hachitzonim alpayim amma o pachot mikkan uven hashshenayim hachitzonim matayim shalosh ushemonim pachot shelish kede sheyyihye ben kol echad mehen uven haemtzai keshettire oto keillu hu benehen mea vearbaim veachat amma ushelish hare shelashtan kimdina achat umoddin alpayim amma lechol ruach michutz lishlashtan. ir shehukkefa ulevassof yashva moddin lah mishivatah. yashva ulevassof hukkefa moddin lah mechomoteha: 
Ir shehayta arukka o merubbaat hoil veyesh lah arba zaviyyot shavot mannichin otah kemot shehi umoddin lah alpayim amma lechol ruach mearba ruchoteha. hayta agulla osin lah zaviyyot veroin otah keillu hu betoch hamerubba umoddin chutz mitztzalot oto merubba alpayim amma lechol ruach shennimtza mistakker hazzaviyyot: 
Vechen im hayta hair meshulleshet o sheyyesh lah tzelaot rabbot merabbein otah veachar kach moddin chutz lamrubba alpayim amma lechol ruach. ucheshehu merabbeah merabbeah beribbua haolam kede shettehe kol ruach mimmenna meshucha keneged ruach meruchot haolam umechuvvenet kenegdah: 
Hayta rechava mitztzad echad uketzara mitztzad echad roin otah keillu hi kullah rechava. hayta asuya kemin gam o shehayta asuya kekeshet im yesh ben shene rasheha pachot mearbaat alafim amma moddin lah min hayyeter veroin et kol harochav shebben hayyeter vehakkeshet keillu hu male battim. veim haya ben shene rasheha arbaat alafim en moddin lah ella min hakkeshet: 
Ir sheyyoshevet al sefat hannachal. im yesh lefaneha dakka rochav arba ammot al sefat hannachal kede sheyyaamdu aleha veyishtammeshu bannachal nimtza hannachal bichlal hair umoddin lah alpayim amma missefat hannachal hashsheniyya veyease hannachal kullo bichlal hammedina mippene haddakka habbenuya mitztziddo. veim lo haya sham dakka en moddin lahen ella mippetach battehen venimtza hannachal nimdad min haalpayim shellahem: 
Yoshve tzerifin en moddin lahen ella mippetach battehen. veim yesh sham shalosh chatzerot shel shene shene battim hukbeu kullam umerabbein otah venotnin lahem alpayim amma lechol ruach kishar haayarot: 
En moddin ella bechevel shel chamishshim amma lo pachot velo yeter uvechevel shel pishtan kede shello yimmashech yoter midday. higgia legay im haya rachbo chamishshim amma sheyyachol lehavelio bechevel hammidda mavlio vehu sheyyihye beamko pachot mearbaat alafim: 
Bamme devarim amurim shehaya chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo shei efshar lehishtammesh bo. aval im en chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo eno mavlio ella im ken haya amko alpayim o pachot mikken: 
Haya gay meukkam mekadder veole mekadder veyored. haya gay rachav mechamishshim sheeno yachol lehavelio holech lemakom shehu yachol lehavelio umavlio vetzofe keneged middato vechozer: 
Higgia lechotel en omrim yikkov et hakkotel ella omed rachbo veholech lo. veim efshar lehishtammesh bo moddo medida yafa. veim haya chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo moded rachbo medida yafa: 
Higgia lehar im haya har mitlakket mimmennu gavoah asara tefachim beorech chamesh ammot mavlio vechozer lemiddato. veim haya gavoah harebe ad sheyyitlakket mimmennu asara tefachim mittoch meshech arba ammot omdo veholech lo. veim eno yachol lehavelio kegon shehaya rachbo yeter mechamishshim mekaddero meat meat. veze hu sheamru mekadderin beharim: 
Ketzad mekadderin beharim o begeayot sheeno yachol lehavelian. ochazin shenayim chevel shel arba ammot haelyon ochez ketzato mikkeneged margelotav vehattachton ochez bakkatze hashsheni keneged libbo vechozer haelyon laamod bimkom hattachton vehattachton yored umarchik mimmennu middat hachevel vechen mitgalgelim veholchin ad shemmoddin et kullo. uchesheyyelech hammoded lehavelia hahar o haggay lo yetze chutz lattechum shello yiru oto haovrim veyomru middat techumin baa lechan: 
En somchin ella al medidat adam mumche shehu yodea middat hakkarka. hayu lanu techume shabbat muchzakin uva mumche umadad ribba battechum mehen umiet battechum. shomin lo battechum sheribba. vechen im bau shenayim mumchin umaddu hattechum echad ribba veechad miet shomin lamrabbe. uvilvad shello yerabbe yeter mimmiddat alachsonah shel ir: 
Ketzad. beet sheyyerabbe ze nomar shemma harishon mikkeren alachson shel ir madad haalpayim ulefichach miet middato venimtza tzela hattechum beno uven hammedina pachot mealpayim. veze haacharon madad alpayim mitztzela hammedina. veen machazikin al harishon shettaa beyoter al ze. lefichach im ribba ze haacharon yeter al harishon afillu bachamesh meot ushemonim amma bekeruv shomin lo. beyoter al ze en shomin lo: 
Afillu eved afillu shifcha neemanin lomar ad kan techum hashshabbat. veneeman haggadol lomar zachur ani shead kan hayinu baim beshabbat keshehayiti katan. vesomchin al eduto bedavar ze. shello amru chachamim baddavar lehachamir ella lehakel mippene sheshshiur alpayim amma middivrehem:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 29: Mitzvat ase min hattora lekaddesh et yom hashshabbat bidvarim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 8)</small> "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho". kelomar zachrehu zechirat shevach vekiddush. vetzarich lezachrehu bichnisato uvitziato. bichnisato bekiddush hayyom uvitziato behavedala:

Veze hu nosach kiddush hayyom. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav veratza vanu veshabbat kadsho beahava veratzon hinchilanu zikkaron lemaase vereshit techilla lemikrae kodesh zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkol haammim veshabbat kadshecha beahava uveratzon hinchaltanu baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat:

Veze hu nosach hahavdala. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase baruch atta Adonai hammavdil ben kodesh lechol:

Ikkar hakkiddush ballayla. im lo kiddesh ballayla ben beshogeg ben bemezid mekaddesh veholech kol hayyom kullo. veim lo hivdil ballayla mavdil lemachar umavdil veholech ad sof yom shelishi. aval eno mevarech al haur ella belel motzae shabbat bilvad:

Asur leadam leechol o lishtot yayin mishshekkadash hayyom ad sheyyekaddesh. vechen mishsheyyatza hayyom asur lo lehatechil leechol velishtot velaasot melacha o litom kelum ad sheyyavdil. velishtot mayim muttar. shachach o avar veachal veshata kodem sheyyekaddesh o kodem sheyyavdil hare ze mekaddesh umavdil achar sheachal:

Middivre sofrim lekaddesh al hayyayin ulehavdil al hayyayin. veaf al pi shehivdil battefilla tzarich lehavedil al hakkos. umeachar sheyyavdil veyomar ben kodesh lechol muttar lo laasot melacha af al pi shello hivdil al hakkos. umevarech al hayyayin techilla veachar kach mekaddesh. veeno notel et yadav ad sheyyekaddesh:

Ketzad hu ose. lokeach kos shehu machazik reviit o yeter umedicho mibbifnim veshotfo mibbachutz umemalleehu yayin veochazo bimino umagbiho min hakkarka tefach o yeter velo yesayyea bismol. umevarech al haggefen veachar kach mekaddesh. uminhag pashut bechol yisrael likrot battechilla parashat <small>(Bereshit 2 1)</small> "vaychullu" veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mekaddesh veshote melo lugmav umashke lechol bene chavura veachar kach notel yadav umevarech hammotzi veochel:

En kiddush ella bimkom seudda. ketzad. lo yekaddesh bevayit ze veyochal bevayit acher. aval im kiddesh bezavit zo ochel bezavit sheniyya. velamma mekaddeshin bevet hakkeneset mippene haorchin sheochlin veshotin sham:
Haya mitavve lappat yoter min hayyayin o shello haya lo yayin hare ze notel yadav techilla umevarech hammotzi umekaddesh veachar kach botzea veochel. veen mavdilin al happat ella al hakkos:

Mi shennitkavven lekaddesh al hayyayin belele shabbat veshachach venatal yadav kodem sheyyekaddesh hare ze mekaddesh al happat veeno mekaddesh al hayyayin achar shennatal yadav lasseudda. umitzva levarech al hayyayin beyom hashshabbat kodem sheyyisod seudda sheniyya. veze hu hannikra kiddusha rabba. mevarech bore peri haggafen bilvad veshote veachar kach yittol yadav veyisod. veasur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyyekaddesh. vegam kiddush ze lo yihye ella bimkom seudda:

Yesh lo leadam lekaddesh al hakkos erev shabbat mibbeod yom af al pi shello nichnesa hashshabbat. vechen mavdil al hakkos mibbeod yom af al pi sheadayin hi shabbat. shemmitzvat zechira leamrah ben bishat kenisato vitziato ben kodem leshaa zo kimat:

Mi shehaya ochel beerev shabbat vekadash alav hayyom vehu betoch hasseudda pores mappa al hashshulchan umekaddesh vegomer seuddato veachar kach mevarech birkat hammazon. haya ochel beshabbat veyatza hashshabbat vehu betoch seuddato gomer seuddato venotel yadav umevarech birkat hammazon al hakkos veachar kach mavdil alav. veim haya betoch hashshetiyya posek umavdil veachar kach chozer lishtiyyato:

Haya ochel vegamar achilato im hachenasat shabbat mevarech birkat hammazon techilla veachar kach mekaddesh al kos sheni. velo yevarech vaykaddesh al kos echad sheen osin shete mitzvot bechos echad. shemmitzvat kiddush umitzvat birkat hammazon shete mitzvot shel tora hen:

En mekaddeshin ella al hayyayin harauy lenassech al gabbe hammizbeach. lefichach im nitarev bo devash o seor afillu ketippat hachardal bechavit gedola en mekaddeshin alav. kach anu morin bechol hammaarav. veyesh mi shemmattir lekaddesh alav veomer lo neemar hayyayin harauy lenassech al gabbe hammizbeach ella lehotzi yayin sherecho ra o megulle o mevushshal sheen mekaddeshin al echad mehen:

Yayin shettaamo taam chometz af al pi sherecho reach yayin en mekaddeshin alav. vechen shemarim shennatan alehen mayim af al pi sheyyesh bahen taam yayin en mekaddeshin alehen. bamme devarim amurim beshennatan al hashshemarim shelosha mayim vehotzi pachot mearbaa. aval im hotzi arbaa hare ze yayin mazug umekaddeshin alav:
Keli shehaya male yayin afillu machazik kamma reviiyyot im shata mimmennu meat hare ze pegamo venifsal veen mekaddeshin al hashshear mippene shehu keshiyyure kosot:

Yayin sherecho reach hachometz vetaamo taam yayin mekaddeshin alav. vechen yayin mazug. vechen yen tzimmukim mekaddeshin alav vehu sheyyihyu tzimmukim sheyyesh bahen lachluchit sheim yidroch otan yetze mehen divshan. vechen yayin chadash miggitto mekaddeshin alav. vesochet adam eshkol shel anavim umekaddesh alav bishato. medina sherov yenah shechar af al pi shehu pasul lekiddush muttar lehavedil alav hoil vehu chamar hammedina:

Keshem shemmekaddeshin belele shabbat umavdilin bemotzae shabbat kach mekaddeshin belele yamim tovim umavdilin bemotzaehen uvemotzae yom hakkippurim shekkullam shabbetot Adonai hen. umavdilin bemotzae yamim tovim lechullo shel moed uvemotzae shabbat leyom tov. aval en mavdilim bemotzae yom tov leshabbat:

Nosach kiddush yom tov. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkol am verommanu mikkol lashon bachar banu vayyegaddelenu ratza banu vayyefaarenu. vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu beahava moadim lesimcha chaggim uzemannim lesason et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze et yom chag hammatztzot hazze o chag hashshavuot o chag hassukkot zeman cherutenu o zeman mattan toratenu o zeman simchatenu beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkol haammim umoade kadshecha besimcha uvesason hinchaltanu baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim. veim chal lihyot beshabbat mazkir shabbat vechotem kederech shechotem battefilla mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim:

Berosh hashshana omer. vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu beahava et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze zichron terua mikra kodesh beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkol haammim udevarcha emet vekayyam laad baruch atta Adonai melech al kol haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veyom hazzikkaron. veim chal lihyot beshabbat chotem mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veyom hazzikkaron kederech shechotem battefilla:
Belele yom tov mekaddesh al hayyayin kivshabbat. veim en lo yayin o shehaya mitavve lefat mekaddesh al happat. vechen beyom tov mekaddesh kiddusha rabba kederech shemmekaddesh beshabbat:

Ketzad mevarchin belele yom tov shechal lihyot beechad beshabbat. battechilla mevarech al haggefen. veachar kach mekaddesh kiddush yom tov. veachar kach mevarech al hanner. veachar kach mavdil vechotem behavedala hammavdil ben kodesh lekodesh. veachar kach mevarech shehecheyanu:
Kol lele yom tov uvelel yom hakkippurim omrim shehecheyanu. uvishvii shel pesach en mevarchin shehecheyanu mippene sheeno regel bifne atzmo uchevar berech al hazzeman bitchillat happesach:
Seder havedala bemotzae shabbat. mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach al habbesamim veachar kach al hanner. vechetzad mevarech al hanner, bore meore haesh. veachar kach mavdil:

En mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu leoro kede sheyyakkir ben matbea medina zo lematbea medina acheret. veen mevarchin al hanner shel ovde kochavim umazzalot shessetam mesibbatan laavodat kochavim umazzalot. veen mevarchin lo al hanner shel avodat kochavim umazzalot velo al hanner shel metim:

Yisrael shehidlik meoved kochavim umazzalot o oved kochavim umazzalot miyyisrael mevarchin alav. oved kochavim umazzalot meovde kochavim umazzalot en mevarchin alav. haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veraa or im rov anshe hakkerach ovde kochavim umazzalot eno mevarech veim rov yisrael mevarech. ur shel kivshan shel tannur veshel kirayim lechattechilla lo yevarech alav. haggechalim im kesheyyachnis kesam benehen dolek meelav mevarchin alehen. ur shel bet hammidrash im yesh sham adam chashuv shemmadlikim bishvilo mevarchin alav. shel bet hakkeneset im yesh sham chazzan shehu dar sham mevarchin alav. vaavuka lehavedala mitzva min hammuvchar. veen mechazzerin al haur kederech shemmechazzerin al kol hammitzvot ella im yesh lo mevarchin alav:

Ur shehudlak beshabbat lechole ulechayya mevarchin alav bemotzae shabbat. ur shehukdach min haetzim umin haavanim mevarchin alav bemotzae shabbat shehi hayta techillat beriyyato bide adam. aval en mevarchin alav bemotzae yom hakkippurim sheen mevarchin bemotzae yom hakkippurim ella al ur sheshshavat. af al pi shehudlak lechole o lechayya beyom hakkippurim mevarchin alav shehare shavat meavera:

Yom tov shechal lihyot beemtza shabbat omer behavedala hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech uven yisrael laammim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase kederech sheomer bemotzae shabbat shesseder hahavdalot hu mone. veeno tzarich levarech lo al habbesamim velo al hanner. vechen eno tzarich levarech al habbesamim bemotzae yom hakkippurim:
Velamma mevarchim al habbesamim bemotzae shabbat mippene shehannefesh doevet litziat shabbat mesammechin otah umeyashshevin otah bereach tov:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 30: Arbaa devarim neemru beshabbat. shenayim min hattora. ushenayim middivre sofrim vehen meforashin al yede hanneviim. shebbattora <small>(Shemot 20 7)</small> "zachor" v <small>(Devarim 5 11)</small> "shamor". veshennitparshu al yede hanneviim kavod vaoneg shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "vekarata lashshabbat oneg velikdosh Adonai mechubbad":

Ezehu kavod ze sheamru chachamim shemmitzva al adam lirchotz panav yadav veraglav bechammin beerev shabbat mippene kevod hashshabbat umitattef betzitzit veyoshev bechoved rosh meyachel lehakebalat pene hashshabbat kemo shehu yotze likrat hammelech. vachachamim harishonim hayu mekabbetzin talmidehen beerev shabbat umitattefim veomrim bou venetze likrat shabbat hammelech:

Umikkevod hashshabbat sheyyilbash kesut nekiyya. velo yihye malbush hchol kemalbush hashshabbat. veim en lo lehachalif meshalshel tallito kede shello yehe malbusho kemalbush hachol. veezra tikken sheyyehu haam mechabbesim bachamishi mippene kevod hashshabbat:

Asur likboa seudda umishte beerev shabbat mippene kevod hashshabbat. umuttar leechol velishtot ad shettechshach. veaf al pi chen mikkevod hashshabbat sheyyimmana adam min hammincha ulemala millikboa seudda kede sheyyikkanes leshabbat keshehu mitavve leechol:

Mesadder adam shulchano beerev shabbat veaf al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit. vechen mesadder shulchano bemotzae shabbat veaf al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit. kede lechabbedo bichnisato uvitziato. vetzarich letakken beto mibbeod yom mippene kevod hashshabbat. veyihye ner daluk veshulchan aruch leechol umitta mutztzaat shekkol ellu lichvod shabbat hen:

Af al pi shehaya adam chashuv beyoter veen darko likkach devarim min hashshuk velo lehitassek bimlachot shebbabbayit chayyav laasot devarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat begufo shezze hu kevodo. chachamim harishonim mehem mi shehaya mefatztzel haetzim levashshel bahen. umehen mi shehaya mevashshel o moleach basar o godel petilot o madlik nerot. umehen mi shehaya yotze vekone devarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat mimmaachol umashke af al pi sheen darko bechach. vechol hammarbe bedavar ze hare ze meshubbach:

Ezehu oneg zehu sheamru chachamim shetztzarich letakken tavshil shamen beyoter umashke mevussam leshabbat hakkol lefi mamono shel adam. vechol hammarbe behotzaat shabbat uvetikkun maachalim rabbim vetovim hare ze meshubbach. veim en yado masseget afillu lo asa ella shelek vechayyotze bo mishshum kevod shabbat hare ze oneg shabbat. veeno chayyav lehatzer leatzmo velishl meacherim kede leharebot bemaachol beshabbat. amru chachamim harishonim ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot:

Mi shehaya anog veashir vahare kol yamav keshabbat tzarich leshannot maachal shabbat mimmaachal hachol. veim i efshar leshannot meshanne zeman haachila im haya ragil lehakedim meacher veim haya ragil leacher makdim:

Chayyav adam leechol shalosh seuddot beshabbat achat arvit veachat shacharit veachat bemincha. vetzarich lehizzaher beshalosh seuddot ellu shello yifchot mehen kelal. vaafillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka soed shalosh seuddot. veim haya chole merov haachila o shehaya mitanne tamid patur mishshalosh seuddot. vetzarich likboa kol seudda mishshelashtan al hayyayin velivtzoa al shete kikkarot. vechen beyamim tovim:

Achilat basar ushetiyyat yayin beshabbat oneg hu lo. vehu shehayta yado masseget. veasur likboa seudda al hayyayin beshabbat uveyamim tovim bishat bet hammidrash. ella kach haya minhag hatztzaddikim harishonim mitpallel adam beshabbat shacharit umusaf bevet hakkeneset veyavo leveto veyisod seudda sheniyya veyelech levet hammidrash yikra veyishne ad hammincha veyitpallel mincha veachar kach yikba seudda shelishit al hayyayin veyochal veyishte ad motzae shabbat:

Asur lo laadam sheyyehallech bearve shabbatot yoter mishshalosh parsaot mittechillat hayyom kede sheyyaggia leveto veod hayyom rav veyachin seudda leshabbat. shehare en anshe beto yodin shehayyom yavo kede lehachin lo. veen tzarich lomar im haya mitareach etzel acherim shehare mevayyeshan mippene shello hechinu lahen davar harauy leorchin:

Asur lehitannot velizok ulehitchannen ulevakkesh rachamim beshabbat vaafillu betzara min hatztzarot shehatztzibbur mitannin umatriin alehen en mitannin velo matriin beshabbat. velo beyamim tovim. chutz meir shehikkifuha ovde kochavim umazzalot o nahar o sefina hammittarefet bayyam shemmatriin alehen beshabbat leazran umitchannenin umevakkeshin alehen rachamim:

En tzarin al ayarot shel ovde kochavim umazzalot pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem hashshabbat. kede shettityashshev daat anshe hammilchama alehen velo yihyu mevohalim uterudim beshabbat. en mafligin bisfina pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem hashshabbat kede shettityashshev dato alav kodem hashshabbat velo yitztaer yeter midday. velidvar mitzva maflig bayyam afillu beerev shabbat. ufosek immo lishbot veeno shovet. umitztzor letzidon vechayyotze bahen afillu lidvar harshut muttar lehafelig beerev shabbat. umakom shennahagu shello yaflig beerev shabbat kelal en mafligin:

Tashmish hammitta meoneg shabbat hu. lefichach onat talmide chachamim habberiim meshammeshin millele shabbat lelele shabbat. umuttar livol betula lechattechilla beshabbat veen baze lo mishshum chovel velo mishshum tzaar lah:

Hashshabbat vaavodat kochavim umazzalot kol achat mishshetehen shekula keneged shear kol mitzvot hattora. vehashshabbat hi haot shebben hakkadosh baruch hu uvenenu leolam. lefichach kol haover al shear hammitzvot hare hu bichlal rishe yisrael. aval hamechallel shabbat befarhesya hare hu keoved avodat kochavim umazzalot ushenehem keovde kochavim umazzalot lechol divrehem. lefichach meshabbeach hannavi veomer <small>(yeshaya 56 2)</small> "ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo" vegomer. vechol hashshomer et hashshabbat kehilchatah umechabbedah umeannegah kefi kocho kevar meforash bakkabbala secharo baolam hazze yeter al hassachar hatztzafun laolam habba. shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach yad)</small> "az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha ki pi Adonai dibber".
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 1: Chatzer sheyyesh bah shechenim harebe kol echad mehem bevayit leatzmo din tora hu sheyyihyu kullan muttarin letaltel bechol hechatzer umibbattim lechatzer umehechatzer labbattim mippene shekkol hechatzer reshut hayyachid achat umuttar letaltel bechullah. vechen haddin bemavoy sheyyesh lo lechi o kora sheyyihyu kol bene hammavoy muttarim letaltel bechullo umechatzerot lammavoy umimmavoy lachatzerot shekkol hammavoy reshut hayyachid hu. vechen haddin bimdina shehi mukkefet choma gevoha asara tefachim sheyyesh lah delatot veninalot ballayla shekkullah reshut hayyachid hi. ze hu din tora:

Aval middivre sofrim asur lishchenim letaltel birshut hayyachid sheyyesh bah chaluka bediyyurin ad sheyyearvu kol hashshechenim kullan meerev shabbat. echad chatzer veechad mavoy veechad hammedina. vedavar ze takkanat shelomo uvet dino:

Vechen yoshve ohalim o sukkot o machane shehikkifuhu mechitztza en metaltelin meohel leohel ad sheyyearvu kullan. aval shayyara shehikkifa mechitztza en tzerichin learev ella motziin meohel leohel belo eruv lefi shehen kullan meoravin veen otan ohalim kevuin lahen:

Umippene ma tikken shelomo davar ze. kede shello yitu haam veyomru keshem shemmuttar lehotzi min hachatzerot lirchovot hammedina ushevakeha ulehachnis mehem lachatzerot kach muttar lehotzi min hammedina lassade ulehachnis min hassade lammedina. veyachshevu shehashshevakim veharchovot hoil vehen reshut lakkol hare hen kesadot uchemidbarot veyomru shehachatzerot bilvad hen reshut hayyachid vidammu sheen hahotzaa melacha veshemmuttar lehotzi ulehachnis mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim:

Lefichach tikken shekkol reshut hayyachid shettechellak bediyyurin veyochaz kol echad veechad bah reshut leatzmo veyishshaer mimmenna makom birshut kullan veyad kullan shava bo kegon chatzer labbattim. shennachshov oto hammakom sheyyad kullan shava bo keillu hu reshut larabbim. venechshav kol makom umakom sheachaz kol echad min hashshechenim vechilleko leatzmo shehu bilvad reshut hayyachid. veyihye asur lehotzi mershut shechalak leatzmo lirshut sheyyad kullam shava bo. kemo sheen motziin mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. ella yishtammesh kol echad barshut shechalak leatzmo bilvad ad sheyyearvu kullan af al pi shehakkol reshut hayyachid:

Uma hu haeruv hazze. hu sheyyitarvu bemaachol echad shemmannichin oto meerev shabbat. kelomar shekkullanu meoravin veochel echad lechullanu veen kol echad mimmennu cholek reshut mechavero ella keshem sheyyad kullanu shava bemakom ze shennishar lechullanu kach yad kullanu shava bechol makom sheyyochez kol echad leatzmo vahare kullanu reshut echad. uvammaase hazze lo yavou litot uledammot shemmuttar lehotzi ulehachnis mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim:
Haeruv sheosim bene hechatzer ze im ze hu hannikra eruve chatzerot. vesheosin anshe mavoy ze im ze o kol bene hammedina hu hannikra shittuf:

En mearvin bachatzerot ella befat shelema bilvad. afillu kikkar maafe sea vehi perusa en mearvin bah. hayta shelema vehi keisar mearvin bah. ucheshem shemmearvin befat tevua kach mearvin befat orez uvefat adashim aval lo befat dochan. veshittuf ben befat ben bishar ochalim. bechol ochel mishtattefin chutz min hammayim bifne atzman o melach bifne atzmo. vechen kemehin ufitriyyot en mishtattefin bahen sheenan chashuvin koochalim. erev mayim im melach naasa kemureyas umishtattefin:

Vechamma shiur haochel shemmishtattefin bo. kigrogeret lechol echad veechad mibbene hammavoy o mibbene hammedina. vehu sheyyihyu shemone esre o pachot. aval im hayu merubbim al ze shiuro shete seuddot shehen kishmone esre gerogarot shehen keshesh betzim benoniyyot. afillu hayu hammishtattefin alafim urevavot shete seuddot lechullan:

Kol ochel shehu neechol kemot shehu kegon pat umine dagan uvasar chay im nishtattefu bo shiuro mezon shete seuddot. vechol shehu liftan vederech haam leechol bo pittan kegon yayin mevushshal uvasar tzali vechometz umureyas vezetim veimmahot shel betzalim shiuro kede leechol bo shete seuddot:

Nishtattefu beyayin chay shiuro shete reviiyyot lechullan. vechen beshechar shete reviiyyot. betzim shetayim umishtattefin bahen vaafillu hen chayyot. verimmonim shenayim. etrog echad. chamishsha egozim. chamishsha afarsekim. litra shel yarak ben chay ben shaluk veim haya bashil velo bashil en mearvin bo lefi sheeno rauy laachila. ukkela tavlin. kav temarim. kav gerogarot. mane devela. kav tappuchin. keshut kimlo hayyad. polin lachin kimlo hayyad. chazin litra. vehatteradin hare hen bichlal hayyarak umearvin bahen. ale betzalim en mearvin bahen. ella im hivtzilu venaasa orech kol ale mehen zeret. aval pachot mikkan eno ochel. vechol ellu haddevarim haamurin keliftan hen. ulefichach natnu bahen shiurin ellu. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. vechol hoochalin mitztarfin leshiur hashshittuf:

Litra haamura bechol makom melo shete reviiyyot. veukkela chatzi reviit. umane haamura bechol makom mea dinar. vehaddinar shesh main. vehammaa mishkal shesh esre seorot. vehassela arbaa dinarin. veharviit machzeket min hammayim o min hayyayin mishkal shiva asar dinarin vachatzi dinar bekeruv. nimtza hallitra mishkal chamishsha usheloshim dinar. vehaukkela mishkal tisha dinarin pachot revia:
Sea haamura bechol makom sheshet kabbin. vehakkav arbaa login. vehallog arba reviiyyot. uchevar bearnu middat harviit umishkalah. veellu hashshiurin sheadam tzarich lizkor otan tamid:

Ochel shehu muttar baachila af al pi shehu asur leze hamearev hare ze mearev bo umishtattef bo. ketzad. mishtattef hannazir beyayin veyisrael bitruma. vechen hannoder meochel ze o shennishba shello yochlennu mearev bo umishtattef bo. sheim eno rauy laze hare hu rauy leacher:

Aval davar haasur lakkol kegon tevel afillu tevel shel divre sofrim. vechen maaser rishon shello nittela terumato kahogen. vechen maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu kahalacha. en mearvin umishtattefin bahen. aval mearvin umishtattefin bidmay mippene sherauy laaniyyim. uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato. uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu af al pi shello natan et hachomesh sheen hachomesh meakkev. umearvin bemaaser sheni birushalayim mippene shehu rauy sham laachila aval lo bigvulin:

Ketzad mearvin bachatzerot. govin challa achat shelema mikkol bayit uvayit umannichin hakkol bichli echad bevayit echad mibbatte hechatzer afillu bevet hatteven o bevet habbakar o bevet haotzar. aval im natnu bevet shaar afillu bet shaar shel yachid o beachsadra o bemirpeset o bevayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot eno eruv. ucheshemmekabbetz haeruv mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat eruv. veomer beeruv ze yihye muttar lechol bene hechatzer lehotzi ulehachnis mibbayit levayit beshabbat. veyesh lekatan ligbot eruve chatzerot. uvayit shemmannichin bo eruv eno tzarich litten et happat. veim hayu regilin lehanniach bo en meshannin oto mippene darche shalom:

Vechetzad mishtattefin bemavoy. gove ochel kigrogeret mikkol echad veechad o pachot mikkigrogeret im hayu merubbin. umanniach hakkol bichli echad bechatzer mechatzrot hammavoy o bevayit min habbattim afillu bayit katan o achsadra o mirpeset hare ze shittuf. aval im hinnicho baavir mavoy eno shittuf. veim hinniach hakkeli bechatzer tzarich lehagebiah hakkeli min hakkarka tefach kede sheyyihye nikkar. umevarech al mitzvat eruv. veomer beze hashshittuf yihye muttar lechol bene hammavoy lehotzi ulehachnis mechatzerot lammavoy beshabbat:
Chalku et haeruv o et hashshittuf af al pi shehu bevayit echad eno eruv. aval im milleu et hakkeli min haeruv venishar mimmennu meat vehinnichuhu bichli acher muttar:

Hammishtattefin bammavoy tzerichim learev bachatzerot kede shello yishkechu hattinokot torat eruv. shehare en hattinokot makkirin ma naasa bammavoy. lefichach im nishtattefu bammavoy befat somchin alav veen tzerichin learev bachatzerot shehare hattinokot makkirin bappat. bene chavura shehayu mesubbin vekaddash alehen hayyom pat sheal hashshulchan somchin aleha mishshum eruve chatzerot. veim ratzu lismoch aleha mishshum shittuf somchin af al pi shehen mesubbin bechatzer:

Lakach echad mibbene hechatzer pat achat veamar hare zo lechol bene hechatzer o shehu ochel kishte seuddot veamar hare ze lechol bene hammavoy eno tzarich ligbot mikkol echad veechad. aval tzarich lezakkot lahen bo al yede acher. veyesh lo lezakkot al yede beno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo haivri veal yede ishto. aval lo al yede beno uvitto hakketannim velo al yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim mippene sheyyadan keyado. vechen yesh lo lezakkot lahen al yede shifchato haivrit af al pi shehi ketanna. shehakkatan zoche laacherim bedavar shehu middivre sofrim. veeno tzarich lehodia livne hechatzer o livne hammavoy shehare zacha lahen veerev alehen shezzechut hi lahen vezachin lo leadam shello befanav:

En mearvin velo mishtattefin beshabbat ella mibbeod yom. umearvin eruve chatzerot veshittufe mevoot ben hashshemashot af al pi shehu safek min hayyom safek min hallayla. uleolam tzarich sheyyehe haeruv o hashshittuf matzuy veefshar leachlo kol ben hashshemashot. lefichach im nafal alav gal o avad o nisraf o shehaya teruma venitmet mibbeod yom eno eruv. mishshechashecha hare ze eruv. veim safek hare ze eruv shessefek haeruv kasher:

Natan haeruv o hashshittuf bammigdal venaal alav veavad hammafteach kodem shechashecha im i efshar lo lehotzi haeruv ella im ken asa melacha ben hashshemashot hare ze kemi sheavad veeno eruv shehare i efshar leachlo. hifrish terumat maaser o teruma gedola vehitna aleha shello tihye teruma ad shettechshach en mearvin bah sheadayin hi tevel kol ben hashshemashot vetzarich shettihye seudda haruya mibbeod yom:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 2: Anneshe hechatzer sheervu kullan chutz meechad mehen shello erev immahen ben mezid ben shocheach hare ze oser alehen. veasur lechullan lehotzi mibbattehen lechatzer o mechatzer levattehen. bittel lahen ze shello erev reshut chatzero bilvad hare ellu muttarin lehotzi ulehachnis mibbattehen lechatzer umechatzer levattehen aval leveto asur. bittel lahen reshut beto ureshut chatzero hare kullam muttarin. hen mippene sheervu vahare bittel lahen reshut beto vachatzero. vegam hu muttar mippene shello nishar lo reshut vahare hu keoreach etzlam vehaoreach eno oser:

Hamevattel reshuto setam reshut chatzero bittel reshut beto lo bittel. vehamevattel reshuto livne chatzer tzarich levattel lechol echad veechad beferush veomer reshuti mevuttelet lecha ulecha ulecha. vehayyoresh mevattel reshut af al pi shemmet morisho beshabbat shehayyoresh kam tachat morisho lechol davar. uvittul reshut beshabbat muttar lechattechilla:
Bittelu ellu hamearvin reshutan leze shello erev. hu muttar shehare nishar levaddo. vehem asurin shello nishar lahen reshut. veen omrim yihyu keorchim etzlo sheen rabbim orchin etzel echad:

Hayu ellu shello ervu shenayim o yeter. im bittelu reshutam lamarvin hamearvin muttarin veellu shello ervu asurin. veen hamearvin yecholim levattel reshutam lishnayim shello ervu shekkol echad mehen oser al chavero. vaafillu chazar haechad shello erev uvittel reshuto lashsheni shello erev hare ze oser shebbeshaa shebbittelu lo hamearvin asur haya. echad sheerev eno mevattel reshuto leechad shello erev aval haechad shello erev mevattel reshuto leechad sheerev:

Keshem shebbaal habbayit ze mevattel reshuto levaal habbayit ze bechatzer achat kach mevattelin mechatzer lechatzer. umevattelin vechozrin umevattelin. ketzad. shenayim sheshsheruyim bechatzer velo erev. echad mehen mevattel reshuto lashsheni venimtza hashsheni metaltel birshuto shebbittel lo chavero ad sheyyaase tzerachav. vechozer hashsheni umevattel reshuto larishon umetaltel harishon birshuto shebbittel lo. vechen kamma peamim. veyesh bittul reshut bechurba kederech shehu bechatzer:

Mi shebbittel reshuto vechazar vetiltel birshuto shebbittel. im bemezid hotzi hare ze oser alehen shehare lo amad bevittulo. veim beshogeg hotzi eno oser shehare hu omed bevittulo. bamme devarim amurim shello kadmu vehecheziku ellu shebbittel lahen. aval im kadmu vehecheziku vehotziu im chazar hu vehotzi ben beshogeg ben bemezid eno oser alehen:

Shene battim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim vehekifum nachrim mechitztza beshabbat en mevattelin ze laze hoil vei efshar lahem learev meemesh. echad mibbene chatzer shemmet veheniach reshuto leechad min hashshuk. im met mibbeod yom hare hayyoresh sheeno mibbene hechatzer oser alehem. veim met mishshechashecha eno oser alehem. veechad min hashshuk shemmet veheniach reshuto leechad mibbene hechatzer. im mibbeod yom met eno oser alehem shehare kullan meoravim. veim met mishshechashecha oser alehem ad sheyyevattel reshut morisho lahen:

Yisrael veger sheshsheruyim bimara achat umet hagger mibbeod yom af al pi shello hechezik yisrael acher binchasav ad shechashecha hare ze hammachazik oser ad sheyyevattel shehare hu keyoresh. veim met hagger mishshechashecha af al pi shehechezik yisrael acher binchasav eno oser alav ella behettero harishon hu omed:

Yisrael haddar im haoved kochavim umazzalot o im ger toshav bechatzer eno oser alav sheddirat haoved kochavim umazzalot enah dira ella kivhema hu chashuv. veim hayu shene yisreelim o yater veoved kochavim umazzalot shachen immahen hare ze oser alehem. vedavar ze gezera shello yashkinu oved kochavim umazzalot immahen shello yilmedu mimmaasav. velamma lo gazru beyisrael echad veoved kochavim umazzalot echad. mippene sheeno davar matzuy. shehare yifchad shemma yityached immo veyahargennu uchevar asru lehityached im haoved kochavim umazzalot:

Shene yisreelim veoved kochavim umazzalot hashshochnim bechatzer achat veervu hayyisreelim leatzman lo hoilu kelum. vechen im bittelu leoved kochavim umazzalot o bittel lahen o bittelu hayyisreelim ze laze venaasu keyachid im haoved kochavim umazzalot lo hoilu kelum. sheen eruv moil bimkom oved kochavim umazzalot. veen bittul reshut moil bimkom oved kochavim umazzalot. veen lahen takkana ella sheyyiskeru mimmennu reshuto veyease haoved kochavim umazzalot keillu hu oreach immahen. vechen im hayu ovde kochavim umazzalot rabbim maskirin reshutam leyisreelim vehayyisreelim mearvin umuttarin. veyisrael echad shessachar min haoved kochavim umazzalot mearev im shear hayyisreelim veyutteru kullam. veen kol echad tzarich liskor min haoved kochavim umazzalot:

Shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo veyisrael veoved kochavim umazzalot darim bappenimit veyisrael acher bachitzona. o shehaya yisrael veoved kochavim umazzalot bachitzona veyisrael acher bappenimit hare ze oser al hachitzona ad sheyyiskor mimmennu. shehare ragle shene yisreelim veoved kochavim umazzalot metzuyim sham. vehappenimi muttar bappenimit:

Sochrin min haoved kochavim umazzalot afillu beshabbat. shehassechirut kevittul reshut hi sheenah sechirut vaddait ella hekker bilvad. lefichach sochrin min haoved kochavim umazzalot afillu befachot mishsheve peruta. veishto shel oved kochavim umazzalot maskeret shello ledato. vechen sechiro veshammasho maskirin shello ledato. vaafillu haya sechiro o shammasho yisreeli hare ze maskir shello ledato. shaal min haoved kochavim umazzalot makom lehanniach bo chafatzav vehishilo hare nishtattef immo birshuto umaskir shello ledato. hayu leoved kochavim umazzalot ze sechirim o shammashim o nashim rabbim im hiskir echad mehen dayyo:

Shene yisreelim veoved kochavim umazzalot haddarim bechatzer achat vesachru min haoved kochavim umazzalot beshabbat chozer haechad umevattel reshuto lashsheni umuttar. vechen im met haoved kochavim umazzalot beshabbat mevattel hayyisreeli layyisreeli haacher veyihye muttar letaltel:

Oved kochavim umazzalot shehiskir leoved kochavim umazzalot im en harishon yachol lehotzi haoved kochavim umazzalot hashsheni ad sheyyashlim zeman sechiruto sochrin mizze haoved kochavim umazzalot hashsheni shehare nichnas tachat habbealim. veim yesh reshut larishon lehotzi haoved kochavim umazzalot hassocher mimmennu bechol et sheyyirtze. im lo haya hashsheni omed vesachru hayyisreelim min harishon hare ellu muttarin:

Chatzer sheyyisreelim veoved kochavim umazzalot sheruyin bah vehayu challonot petuchot mibbet yisreeli ze levet yisreeli ze veasu eruv derech challonot. af al pi shehen muttarin lehotzi mibbayit levayit derech challonot hare hen asurin lehotzi mibbayit levayit derech petachim mippene haoved kochavim umazzalot ad sheyyaskir. sheen rabbim naasim beeruv keyachid bimkom haoved kochavim umazzalot:

Yisrael shehu mechallel shabbat befarhesya o shehu oved avodat kochavim umazzalot hare hu keoved kochavim umazzalot lechol devarav. veen mearvin immo veeno mevattel reshut ella sochrin mimmennu keoved kochavim umazzalot. aval im haya min haeppikorosin sheen ovdin avodat kochavim umazzalot veen mechallelin shabbat kegon tzedokin uvaytosin vechol hakkofrim battora shebbeal pe, kelalo shel davar kol mi sheeno mode bemitzvat eruv, en mearvin immo lefi sheeno mode baeruv. veen sochrin mimmennu lefi sheeno keoved kochavim umazzalot. aval mevattel hu reshuto leyisrael hakkasher vezo hi takkanato. vechen im haya yisrael echad kasher veze hatztzedoki bechatzer hare ze oser alav ad sheyyevattel lo reshuto:
Mishneh Torah, Eruvin 3: Chalon shebben shete chatzerot im yesh bo arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim o yeter al ze vehaya karov min haaretz betoch asara tefachim. afillu kullo lemala measara umiktzato betoch asara o kullo betoch asara umiktzato lemala measara im ratzu yoshve shete hachatzerot learev kullan eruv echad harshut beyadan veyeasu kechatzer achat vitaltelu mizzo lazo. veim ratzu mearvin shene eruvin ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. haya hachallon pachot mearbaa o shehaya kullo lemala measara mearvin shene eruvin ellu leatzman veellu leatzman:

Bamme devarim amurim bechallon shebben shete chatzerot aval shebben shene battim afillu haya lemala measara. vechen challon shebben bayit laaliyya im ratzu mearvin eruv echad afillu sheen benehem sullam. vehu sheyyihye bo arbaa al arbaa. haya challon agol im yesh bo kede lerabbea bo arbaa al arbaa hare hu kimrubba:

Kotel shebben shete chatzerot o matben shebben shete chatzerot pachot measara tefachim mearvin eruv echad veen mearvin shenayim. haya gavoah asara o yeter al ken mearvin shene eruvin ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. veim haya benehem sullam mikkan vesullam mikkan hare hen kefetach. veim ratzu mearvin echad. vaafillu haya hassullam zakuf vesamuch lakkotel shehare en yecholin laalot bo ad sheyyimmashech veyitrachek mittachtav min hakkotel hare ze mattir. vaafillu lo haya maggia rosh hassullam lerosh hakkotel im nishar benehen pachot mishshelosha hare ze mattir umearvin echad im ratzu:

Haya hakkotel rachav arbaa veasa sullam mikkan vesullam mikkan af al pi shehassullamot meruchakim ze mizze im ratzu mearvin echad. en berochav hakkotel arbaa im en ben hassullamot shelosha mearvin echad. haya benehem shelosha mearvin shenayim:

Bana matztzeva al gabbe matztzeva betzad hakkotel. im yesh battachtona arbaa memaet. en battachtona arbaa veen benah leven haelyona shelosha memaet. veim ratzu mearvin echad. vechen bemadregot shel etz shessemachan lakkotel:

Kotel gavoah shebben shete chatzerot veziz yotze beemtzaito im nishar min hazziz ad rosh hakkotel pachot measara manniach sullam lifne hazziz umearvin echad im ratzu. aval im hinniach hassullam betzad hazziz eno memaet. haya hakkotel gavoah tisha asar tefachim motzi ziz echad baemtza umearvin echad im ratzu shehare min hazziz ad haaretz pachot measara umin hazziz haelyon ad rosh hakkotel pachot measara. haya hakkotel gavoah esrim tefachim tzarich shene zizin ze shello keneged ze. ad sheyyihye ben hazziz hattachton uven haaretz pachot measara uven hazziz haelyon uven rosh hakkotel pachot measara. umearvin echad im ratzu:

Dekel shechatacho usemacho al rosh hakkotel veal haaretz mearvin echad im ratzu veeno tzarich lekavo babbinyan. vechen hassullam kavdo kovo veeno tzarich lechabbero babbinyan. hayu kashshin mavdilin ben shete hachatzerot vesullam mikkan vesullam mikkan en mearvin echad shehare en kaf haregel ola bassullam lefi sheen lo al ma sheyyismoch. haya sullam baemtza vekashshin mikkan vekashshin mikkan im ratzu mearvin shenayim:

Haya ilan betzad hakkotel veasahu sullam lakkotel. im ratzu mearvin echad hoil veissur shevut hu sheggaram lo shello yaale bailan. asa ashera sullam lakkotel en mearvin echad mippene sheasur laalot aleha min hattora shehare hi asura bahanaya:

Kotel sheggavoah asara uva lemaato kede learev eruv echad im yesh beorech hammiut arbaa tefachim mearvin echad. satar miktzat hakkotel ad shennitmaet measara. tziddo hakkatzar notnin oto lechatzer zo ushear hakkotel haggavoah leven shete hachatzerot:

Nifratz hakkotel haggavoah shebbenehen. im hayta happirtza ad eser ammot mearvin shene eruvin. veim ratzu mearvin echad mippene shehi kefetach. hayta yeter meeser mearvin eruv echad veen mearvin shene eruvin:

Hayta happirtza pechuta meeser uva lehashelimah leyeter meeser chokek bakkotel gova asara tefachim umearvin eruv echad. veim ba lifrotz lechattechilla pirtza yeter meeser bechol hakkotel tzarich lihyot gova happirtza melo komato:

Charitz shebben shete chatzerot amok asara verachav arbaa o yeter mearvin shene eruvin. pachot mikkan mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim. veim miet amko beafar o bitzrorot mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim shessetam afar utzerorot becharitz mevuttalin hen. aval im milleahu teven o kash en memaatin ad sheyyevattel:

Vechen im miet rachbo beluach o bekane shehoshito beorech kol hecharitz mearvin echad veen mearvin shenayim. vechol haddavar hannittal beshabbat kegon hassal vehassefel en memaatin bo ella im ken chibbero baaretz chibbur shei efshar leshamto ad sheyyachpor bedeker:

Natan luach sherachav arbaa tefachim al rochav hecharitz mearvin echad veim ratzu mearvin shene eruvin. vechen shete gezuzteraot zo keneged zo im hoshit luach sherachav arbaa tefachim mizzo lezo mearvin eruv echad. veim ratzu mearvin shene eruvin ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. hayu zo betzad zo veenan beshave ella achat lemala mechavertah im yesh benehen pachot mishshelosha tefachim hare hen kichtzotztera achat umearvin achat. veim yesh benehem shelosha o yeter mearvin shenayim ellu leatzman veellu leatzman:

Kotel shebben shete chatzerot shehu rachav arbaa vehaya gavoah asara tefachim mechatzer zo veshave lekarka chatzer sheniyya notnin rachbo livne hechatzer shehu shave lahen veyechashev mechatzeran. hoil vetashmisho benachat leellu vetashmisho bekashe leellu notnin oto leellu shettashmisho lahen benachat. vechen charitz shebben shete chatzerot amok asara tefachim mitztzad chatzer zo veshave lekarka chatzer sheniyya notnin rachbo lechatzer shehi shava lah. mippene shettashmisho nachat laze vekashe laze notnin oto leellu shettashmisho lahen benachat:

Haya hakkotel shebben shete hachatzerot namuch mechatzer haelyona vegavoah mechatzer hattachtona shennimtzeu bene haelyona mishtammeshin beavyo al yede shilshul uvene hattachtona mishtammeshin beavyo al yede zerika shenehen asurin bo ad sheyyearvu shetehen eruv echad. aval im lo ervu en machnisin meovi kotel zo labbattim veen motziin mehabbattim leavyo:

Shene battim shebbenehen churba shehi reshut hayyachid im yecholin shenehem lehishtammesh bachurba al yede zerika osrin ze al ze. veim haya tashmishah laze benachat vehaacher eno yachol lizrok lah mippene shehi amukka mimmennu hare ze shehi lo benachat mishtammesh bah al yede zerika:

Kol gaggot hair af al pi shezze gavoah veze namuch im kol hachatzerot veim kol hakkarpifot shehukkefu shello leshem dira sheen bechol echad mehen yeter al bet satayim im ovi hakketalim shebben hachatzerot im hammevoot sheyyesh lahen lechi o kora kullan reshut achat hen umetaltelin bechullan belo eruv kelim sheshshavtu betochan. aval lo kelim sheshshavtu betoch habbayit ella im ken ervu:

Ketzad. keli sheshshavat betoch hechatzer ben ervu anshe hechatzer ben lo ervu muttar lehaaloto min hechatzer laggag o lerosh hakkotel. umin haggag legag acher hassamuch lo afillu haya gavoah mimmennu kol shehu o namuch. umin haggag haachar lechatzer sheniyya umechatzer sheniyya legag shelishi shel chatzer shelishit. umiggag shelishi lemavoy. umin hammavoy legag revii ad sheyyaavirennu kol hammedina kullah derech gaggot vachatzerot o derech gaggot vekarpifot o derech chatzerot vekarpifot o derech shelashtan mizze laze umizze laze. uvilvad shello yikkanes bichli ze levayit min habbattim ella im ken ervu anshe kol hammekomot haellu eruv echad:

Vechen im shavat hakkeli babbayit vehotzio lechatzer lo yaavirennu lechatzer acheret o legag acher o lerosh hakkotel o lekarpaf ella im ken ervu anshe kol hammekomot shemmaavirin bahen keli ze eruv echad:

Bor shebben shete chatzerot en memallein mimmennu beshabbat ella im ken asu lo mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim kede sheyyihye kol echad veechad dole mershuto. vehechan maamidin et hammechitztza. im hayta lemala min hammayim tzarich sheyyihye tefach min hammechitztza yored betoch hammayim. veim hayta hammechitztza kullah betoch hammayim tzarich sheyyihye tefach mimmenna yotze lemala min hammayim kede shettihye nikkeret reshut ze mershut ze:

Vechen im asu al pi habbor kora rechava arbaa tefachim ze memalle mitztzad hakkora veze memalle mitztziddah haacher ucheillu hivdila chelek ze mechelek ze af al pi shehammayim meoravin millematta kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim:

Beer shebbeemtza hashshevil ben shene katle chatzerot af al pi shehi mufleget mikkotel ze arbaa tefachim umikkotel ze arbaa tefachim shenehem memallein mimmenna veen tzerichin lehotzi zizin al gabbah sheen adam oser al chavero derech avir:

Chatzer ketanna shennifretza bimloah lechatzer gedola mibbeod yom. anshe gedola mearvin leatzman umuttarim shehare nishar lahen petzimin mikkan umikkan. veanshe ketanna asurin lehotzi mibbattehen lechatzer shellahen ad sheyyearvu im bene haggedola eruv echad. sheddiyyurin shel gedola chashuvin kiktanna veen diyyure ketanna chashuvin kigdola:
