Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 5: Af al pi shehuttera hotzaa beyom tov afillu shello letzorech lo yissa massaot gedolot kederech shehu ose bechol ella tzarich leshannot. veim i efshar leshannot muttar. ketzad. hammevi kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom lo yeviem besal uvekuppa aval mevi hu al ketefo o lefanav. hammolich et hatteven lo yafshil et hakkuppa leacharav aval molichah beyado:

Vechen massoot sheddarkan lissa otan bemot yissa otan al gabbo meacharav. vesheddarkan lissa otan meachorav yissa otan al ketefo. vesheddarkan lehinnase al hakkatef yissa otan beyado lefanav o yifrosh alehen beged vechol kayyotze baze mishshinnuy hammassa. veim i efshar leshannot nose umevi kedarko. bamme devarim amurim benose al haadam aval al gabbe behema lo yavi kelal shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol:

En manhigin et habbehema bemakkel. veen hassuma yotze bemaklo velo haroe betarmilo. veen yotzin bechisse echad haish veechad haishsha shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. vish shehayu rabbim tzerichin lo yotzin bechisse acharav umotziin oto al hakkatef afillu beappiryon:

En molichin et hassullam shel shovach mishshovach leshovach birshut harabbim shemma yomru letakken gaggo hu molicho. aval birshut hayyachid molicho. af al pi shekkol makom sheasru chachamim mippene marit haayin afillu bechadre chadarim asur kan hittiru mippene simchat yom tov:

Mi shehayu lo perot al gaggo vetzarich lefannotam lemakom acher lo yoshitem miggag legag vaafillu baggaggin hashshavin. velo yeshalshelem bechevel min hachallonot velo yoridem besullamot shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. aval mashshilan afillu derech arubba mimmakom lemakom beoto haggag. shachat behema bassade lo yevienna bemot lair o bemota aval meviah evarim evarim:

Kol shenneotin bo afillu bechol af al pi sheen neotin bo beyom tov kegon tefillin muttar leshalchan lachavero beyom tov. veen tzarich lomar davar shenneotin bo beyom tov kegon yenot shemanim uselatot shemmuttar leshalchan. vechol davar sheen neotin bo bechol ad sheyyaase bo maase sheasur laasoto beyom tov en meshallechin oto beyom tov:

Ketzad. en meshallechin beyom tov tevua lefi sheen neotin bah bechol ella im ken tachan veasur litchon beyom tov. aval meshallechin kitniyyot mippene shemmevashshelan beyom tov o kole otan veochlan. umeshallechin chayya behema veofot afillu chayyim mippene shemmuttar lishchot beyom tov. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol davar shemmuttar leshalcho beyom tov kesheyyishlachennu lachavero teshura lo yishlachennu beshura veen shura pechuta mishshelosha bene adam. ketzad. hare sheshshalach lachavero behemot o yenot beyad shelosha bene adam keechad o arbaa ze achar ze vechullan holchin beshura achat hare ze asur shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol. shalach shelosha minin beyad shelosha bene adam keechad hare ze muttar:
Hamearev eruve techumin leyom tov hare behemto vechelav uferotav kamohu. veen molichin otan ella betoch alpayim amma lechol ruach mimmekom eruvo:

Cheftze hefker hare hen keragle mi shezzacha bahen. vecheftze hakkutim konin shevita bimkoman veyesh lahen alpayim amma lechol ruach mimmekoman gezera bealim kutim mishshum bealim yisrael. perot sheyyatzu chutz limkoman vechazru afillu bemezid lo hifsidu et mekoman mippene shehen keadam sheyyatza beones vechazar beones:
Hammoser behemto livno hare hi keragle haav. mesarah leroe vaafillu netanah lo beyom tov hare hi keragle haroe. mesarah lishne roim hare hi keragle bealeha mippene shello kana echad mehen:

Mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim beyom tov lo yolichu beyadam manot lemakom sheen baal hasseudda yachol lelech bo. shekkol hasseudda keragle baal hasseudda lo keragle haorchin. ella im ken zacha lahen acher bemanot ellu meerev yom tov:

Vechen mi shehayu perotav mufkadin beir acheret veervu bene otah hair lavo etzlo lo yaviu lo mipperotav shepperotav kamohu af al pi shehen beyad ellu sheervu. bamme devarim amurim besheyyiched lahen keren zavit aval im lo yiched lahen hare hen keragle ze shehen mufkadin etzlo:

Bor shel yachid keragle bealav. veshel otah hair keragle anshe otah hair. veshel ole bavel shehen mesurin lakkol keragle hamemalle mehen shekkol mi shemmille mehen molichan lemakom shehu mehallech. neharot hammoshchin umaayanot hannovin keragle kol adam veim hayu bain michutz lattechum letoch hattechum memallein mehen beshabbat veen tzarich lomar beyom tov:

Shor shel roe keragle anshe otah hair. veshor shel petam keragle mi shellekacho leshochoto beyom tov. mippene sheddaat bealav lemachro laanashim acherim chutz meanshe otah hair mippene shehu mefuttam vehakkol shomin shamo uvain liknoto. vechen im shechato bealav beyom tov umachar besaro. kol echad veechad min hallokchim molich menato lemakom shehu holech mippene sheddaat bealav meerev yom tov kach hu sheyyikchu mimmennu anshe ayarot acherot venimtza shor ze kevor shel ole bavel shehu masur lakkol:
Haggachelet keragle bealeha lo keragle shoalah vehashshalhevet keragle mi shehi beyado. lefichach hammadlik ner o etz mechavero molicho lechol makom shehu holech:

Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov af al pi shello netano lo ella beyom tov hare hu keragle hashshoel. shealo mimmennu beyom tov af al pi sheddarko tamid lishl mimmennu keli ze bechol yom tov hare hu keragle hammashil:

Shenayim sheshshaalu chaluk echad haechad shealo mimmennu sheyyitteno lo shacharit vehashsheni shealo mimmennu sheyyitteno lo arvit hare keli ze keragle shene hashshoalim veenam molichim oto ella bemakom sheshshenehem yecholin lehallech bo:

Ketzad. hare sheerev harishon berichuk elef amma mimmekom hechaluk lemizrach veerev hashsheni berichuk chamesh meot amma mimmekom hechaluk lammaarav. keshellokeach harishon hechaluk eno molicho lammizrach ella ad elef amma vachamesh meot amma mimmekom hechaluk shehu sof hattechum sheyyachol ze sheerev bammaarav lehallech bo. uchesheyyikkach hashsheni keli ze eno molicho bammaarav ella ad elef amma mimmekom hakkeli shehu sof hattechum sheyyachol ze sheerev bammizrach lehallech bo. lefichach im erev ze berichuk alpayim amma min hechaluk lammizrach veze berichuk alpayim amma lammaarav hare ellu lo yezizuhu mimmekomo:

Vechen haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah mayim o melach velasha bahen issatah o bishshela bahen tavshil hare haissa o hattavshil keragle shetehen. vechen shenayim shellakchu behema beshuttafut veshachatu beyom tov af al pi shellakach kol echad menato hare kol habbasar keragle shenehen. aval im lakchu chavit beshuttafut vechalku otah beyom tov hare chelko shel kol echad keraglav. hoil utechumin middivre sofrim yesh berera bahen venachshov keillu chelek shehiggia laze haya barur lo umuvdal bechavit meerev yom tov ucheillu lo haya meorav. veen atta yachol lomar ken bivhema shechelek ze shehiggio afillu nachshov oto shehaya muvdal bivhema meerev yom tov ucheillu haya barur hare yanak mechelko shel chavero keshehayta habbehema kayyemet shekkol evareha yonkin ze mizze venimtza kol evar veevar meorav mechelko vechelek chavero. lefichach hen keragle shenehen:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 6:
Yom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat en ofin umevashshelin beyom tov ma shehu ochel lemachar beshabbat. veissur ze middivre sofrim kede shello yavo levashshel miyyom tov lechol. shekkal vachomer hu leshabbat eno mevashshel kol shekken lechol. lefichach im asa tavshil meerev yom tov sheyyihye somech alav umevashshel veofe beyom tov leshabbat hare ze muttar. vetavshil shessomech alav hu hannikra eruve tavshilin: 
Velamma nikra shemo eruv. shekkeshem shehaeruv sheosin bachatzerot umevoot meerev shabbat mishshum hekker kede shello yaale al datam shemmuttar lehotzi mershut lirshut beshabbat. kach ze hattavshil mishshum hekker vezikkaron kede shello yedammu veyachshevu shemmuttar leefot beyom tov ma sheeno neechol bo bayyom. ulefichach nikra tavshil ze eruve tavshilin: 
Eruve tavshilin shiuro en pachot mikkezayit ben leechad ben laalafim. veen osin eruv ze lo befat velo berifot vechayyotze bahen ella betavshil shehu parperet kegon basar vedagim uvetzim vechayyotze bahen. vaafillu adashim shebbeshule kedera vaafillu shamnunit sheal gabbe hassakkin shechotchin bah hatztzali gordo im yesh bo kezayit somech alav mishshum eruve tavshilin: 
Tavshil sheamru leinyan eruv ze afillu tzali afillu shaluk afillu kavush o meeshshan afillu dagim ketannim shehedichan bemayim chammin vahadachatan hi bishshulan laachila hare ze somech alehen: 
Vetzarich sheyyihye eruv ze matzuy ad sheyyofe kol ma shehu tzarich leefot ulevashshel kol shehu tzarich levashshel. veyachem chammin kol shehu tzarich. veim neechal haeruv o avad o nisraf kodem sheyyevashshel o yofe hare ze asur leefot ulevashshel o lehachem ella ma shehu ochel beyom tov bilvad. hitchil beissato o betavshilo veneechal haeruv o avad hare ze gomer: 
Hammeniach eruve tavshilin kede sheyyismoch alehem hu vaacherim tzarich lezakkot lahen kederech shemmezakke beeruve shabbat. vechol shezzoche beeruve shabbat zoche beeruve tavshilin. vechol sheeno zoche beoto eruv eno zoche baze: 
Veeno tzarich lehodia leellu shezzikka lahen meerev yom tov. aval hen tzerichin leda shekkevar zikka lahen acher veerev lahen veachar kach yismechu alav vivashshelu veyofu. af al pi shello yadu ella beyom tov hare ellu muttarin. veyesh lo leadam learev al kol hair veal kol hakkarov eleha betoch hattechum ulemachar machriz veomer kol mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin yismoch al eruvi: 
Hammanniach eruve tavshilin chayyav levarech. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al mitzvat eruv. veomer beeruv ze yuttar li leefot ulevashshel miyyom tov shellemachar leshabbat. veim zacha bo laacherim yomar li velifloni velifloni o leanshe hair kullam leefot ulevashshel miyyom tov leshabbat: 
Mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin velo hinnichu lo acherim. keshem sheasur lo levashshel veleefot kach kimcho umaachalo asur. veasur leacher shehinniach leatzmo levashshel veleefot laze shello hinniach ad sheyyakne lo shennimtza ze mevashshel veofe shello shehare kanahu. veim ratza yitten achar kach laze shello hinniach bemattana: 
Mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin uvishshel veafa leechol bayyom vehotir o shezzimmen orchim velo bau hare ze ochel hammotar lemachar. veim heerim hare ze asur leachlo. avar veafa uvishshel leshabbat en osrin alav. velamma hechmiru veasru al hammaarim velo asru al hammezid sheim tattir lammaarim nimtzeu hakkol maarimin veyishtakkea shem eruve tavshilin. aval hammezid eno matzuy veim avar hayyom lo yaavor paam acheret: 
Shene yamim tovim shechalu lihyot bachamishi veerev shabbat ose eruve tavshilin miyyom revii shehu erev yom tov. shachach velo hinniach mannicho barishon umatne. ketzad. manniach eruve tavshilin beyom chamishi veomer im hayyom yom tov ulemachar chol lemachar avashshel veofe leshabbat veeni tzarich kelum veim hayyom chol ulemachar yom tov baeruv ze yettar li leefot ulevashshel lemachar miyyom tov leshabbat: 
Kayyotze bo hayu lefanav shete kalkalot shel tevel beyom tov rishon omer im hayyom chol tihye zo teruma al zo veim hayyom kodesh en bidvaray kelum. vekore aleha shem umannichah. ulemachar bashsheni chozer veomer im hayyom kodesh en bidvaray kelum veim hayyom chol tihye zo teruma al zo vekore aleha shem umannichah kederech shekkara aleha barishon. umanniach et zo shekkara aleha shem teruma veochel et hashsheniyya: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot aval bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana im shachach velo hinniach beyom revii shuv eno manniach ella somech al acherim im ervu alav o makne kimcho lemi sheerev o yihye asur leefot ulevashshel leshabbat. vechen im shachach velo hifrish teruma miyyom revii shuv eno mafrish ad motzae shabbat: 
Kol haddevarim haellu sheamarnu hayu bizman shehayu bet din shel eretz yisrael mekaddeshin al pi hariyya vehayu bene haggaluyyot osin shene yamim kede lehistallek min hassafek lefi shello hayu yodin yom shekkiddeshu bene eretz yisrael. aval hayyom shebbene eretz yisrael somchin al hacheshbon umekaddeshin alav en yom tov sheni lehistallek min hassafek ella minhag bilvad: 
Ulefichach ani omer sheen mearev adam umatne bazzeman hazze lo eruve tavshilin velo eruve chatzerot velo shittufe mevoot veeno measser hattevel al tenay ella hakkol meerev yom tov bilvad: 
Keshem shemmitzva lechabbed shabbat uleannegah kach kol yamim tovim shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 13)</small> "likdosh Adonai mechubbad" vechol yamim tovim neemar bahen <small>(Vayikra 23 7)</small> "mikra kodesh". uchevar bearnu hakkibbud vehainnug behilchot shabbat. vechen rauy leadam shello yisod bearve yamim tovim min hammincha ulemala keerev shabbat sheddavar ze bichlal hakkavod. vechol hamevazze et hammoadot keillu nitpal laavodat kochavim: 
Shivat yeme happesach ushemonat yeme hechag im shear yamim tovim kullam asurim behesped vetaanit. vechayyav adam lihyot bahen sameach vetov lev hu uvanav veishto uvene beto vechol hannilvim alav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 14)</small> "vesamachta bechaggecha" vegomer. af al pi shehassimcha haamura kan hi karban shelamim kemo sheanu mevaarin behilchot chagiga yesh bichlal otah simcha lismoach hu uvanav uvene beto kol echad karauy lo: 
Ketzad. hakketannim noten lahem kelayot veegozim umigdanot. vehannashim kone lahen begadim vetachshitin naim kefi mamono. vehaanashim ochlin basar veshotin yayin sheen simcha ella bevasar veen simcha ella beyayin. ucheshehu ochel veshote chayyav lehaachil lagger layyatom velaalmana im shear haaniyyim haumlalim. aval mi shennoel daltot chatzero veochel veshote hu uvanav veishto veeno maachil umashke laaniyyim ulemare nefesh en zo simchat mitzva ella simchat kereso. veal ellu neemar <small>(Hoshea 9 4)</small> "zivchehem kelechem onim lahem kol ochlav yittammau ki lachmam lenafsham". vesimcha kazo kalon hi lahem shenneemar <small>(Malachi 2 3)</small> "vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem": 
Af al pi sheachila ushetiyya bammoadot bichlal mitzvat ase. lo yihye ochel veshote kol hayyom kullo. ella kach hi haddat. babboker mashkimin kol haam levatte kenesiyyot ulevatte midrashot umitpallelin vekorin battora beinyan hayyom vechozrin levattehem veochlin. veholchin levatte midrashot korin veshonin ad chatzi hayyom. veachar chatzot hayyom mitpallelin tefillat hammincha vechozrin levattehen leechol velishtot shear hayyom ad hallayla: 
Kesheadam ochel veshote vesameach baregel lo yimmashech beyayin uvischok vekallut rosh veyomar shekkol mi sheyyosif baze yarbe bemitzvat simcha. shehashshichrut vehassechok harabba vekallut harosh enah simcha ella hollut vesichlut velo nitztavvenu al hahollut vehassichlut ella al hassimcha sheyyesh bah avodat yotzer hakkol shenneemar <small>(Devarim 28 47)</small> "tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav merov kl". ha lamadta shehaavoda besimcha. vei efshar laavod et hashshem lo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch shichrut: 
Chayyavin bet din lehaamid shotrim bargalim sheyyihyu mesabbevin umechappesin baggannot uvappardesim veal hanneharot kede shello yitkabbetzu leechol velishtot sham anashim venashim veyavou lide avera. vechen yazhiru bedavar ze lechol haam kede shello yitarvu anashim venashim bevattehem lesimcha. velo yimmashchu bayyayin shemma yavou lide avera: 
Yamim shebben rishon ushevii shel pesach verishon ushemini shel chag hassukkot vehen baggola arbaa betoch happesach vachamishsha betoch hechag hem hannikrain chullo shel moed venikrain moed. veaf al pi shehem chayyavin besimcha vaasurin behesped vetaanit muttar lispod bahen talmid chacham befanav. aval leachar sheyyikkaver asur lesafdo bahen. veen tzarich lomar berashe chodashim bachanukka uvefurim shessofdin bahen talmide chachamim befanav af al pi sheyyamim ellu asurin behesped vetaanit. aval leachar hakkevura asur lispod bahen: 
En mannichin mittat hammet barchov bammoed shello leharegil et hahesped ella mibbeto lekivro. veen mitabbelin bammoed. vechen en korin velo mavrin velo choltzin hakkatef bammoed al hammet ella kerovav shehen chayyavin lehitabbel alav. veim haya chacham o adam kasher o shehaya omed alav bishat netilat neshama hare ze korea alav bammoed af al pi sheeno kerovo. veen korin beyom tov sheni kelal vaafillu kerovav shel met: 
Nashim bammoed bifne hammet meannot aval lo metappechot velo mekonnot. nikbar hammet enan meannot. berashe chodashim vachanukka ufurim bifne hammet meannot umetappechot aval lo mekonnot. e zehu innuy shekkullan onot keachat. kina achat omeret vechullan onot. veasur leadam sheyyeorer al meto kodem laregel sheloshim yom kede shello yavo haregel vehu neetzav velibbo doeg vechoev mizzichron hatztzaar ella yasir haddeaga millibbo vichavven dato lesimcha:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 7: Chulo shel moed af al pi shello neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 23 24)</small> <small>(Vayikra 23 39)</small> "shabbaton" hoil venikra <small>(Vayikra 23 7)</small> "mikra kodesh" vahare hu zeman chagiga bammikdash asur baasiyyat melacha kede shello yihye kishar yeme hachol sheen bahen kedushsha kelal. vehaose bo melacha haasura makkin oto makkat mardut mippene sheissuro middivre sofrim. velo kol melechet avoda asura bo keyom tov shessof hainyan baddevarim shenneesru bo kede shello yihye keyom chol lechol davar. lefichach yesh melachot asurot bo veyesh melachot muttarot bo:

Veellu hen. kol melacha sheim lo yaase otah bammoed yihye sham hefsed harebe osin otah. uvilvad shello yihye bah torach harebe. ketzad. mashkin bet hashshelachin bammoed aval lo bet hammashke. sheim lo yashke bet hashshelachin vehi haaretz hatztzemea yippasdu bo hailanot shebbah. ucheshehu mashke otah lo yidle veyashke min habberecha o mimme haggeshamim mippene shehu torach gadol. aval mashke hu min hammayan ben shehaya ben sheyyatza lechattechilla mamshicho umashke bo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hofech adam et zetav bammoed vetochen otan vedorech otan umemalle hechaviyyot vegaf otan kederech shehu ose bechol. kol sheyyesh bo hefsed im lo naasa osehu kedarko veeno tzarich shinnuy. vechen machnis adam perotav mippene haggannavim uvilvad sheyyachnisem betzina. veshole pishtano min hammishre bishvil shello tovad. vechen kerem shehiggia zemanno lehibbatzer bammoed botzrin oto:

Veasur laadam sheyyitkavven viacher melachot ellu vechayyotze bahen veyannichem kede laasotan bammoed mippene shehu panuy. vechol hamechavven melachto vehinnichah lammoed vaasaah bammoed bet din meabbedin otah umafkirin otah lakkol. veim kivven melachto umet en konsin beno acharav veen meabbedin otah mimmennu. veen monin habben millaasot otah melacha bammoed kede shello tovad:

Mi shetztzarach litpor lo beged o livnot lo makom bammoed. im haya hedyot veeno mahir beotah melacha hare ze ose otah kedarko. veim haya umman mahir hare ze ose otah maase hedyot. ketzad. bitfira machliv uvevinyan manniach avanim veeno tach betit alehen veshaf sidke hakkarka umaagilah bayyad uvaregel keen shemmaagilim bemachlatzayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shehayta lo tevua mechubberet lakkarka veen lo ma sheyyochal bammoed ella mimmenna af al pi sheen kan hefsed en matzrichin oto liknot ma sheyyochal min hashshuk ad sheyyiktzor achar hammoed ella kotzer umeammer vedash vezore uvorer vetochen ma shehu tzarich. uvilvad shello yadush befarot. shekkol davar sheen bo hefsed tzarich leshannot. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kevashim sheyyachol leechol mehen bammoed kovshan. vesheenan reuyin ella leachar hammoed asur lechavshan. vetzad adam dagim kol sheyyachol latzud umoleach hakkol bammoed shehare efshar sheyyochal mehen bammoed im yischot otan beyado peamim rabbot ad sheyyitrakkechu:

Metilin shechar bammoed letzorech hammoed. veshello letzorech hammoed asur. echad shechar temarim veechad shechar seorim. af al pi sheyyesh lo yashan maarim veshote min hechadash sheen haarama zo nikkeret laroe. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol melachot shehen letzorech hammoed kesheosin otan ummanehen osin betzina. ketzad. hatztzayyadim vehattochanin vehabbotzrin limkor bashshuk hare ellu osin betzina letzorech hammoed. veim asa letzorech hammoed vehotir hare ze muttar:

Osin kol tzarche harabbim bammoed. ketzad. metakkenim kilkule hammayim shebbirshut harabbim. umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot. vechofrim larabbim borot shichin umearot. vechorin lahen neharot kede sheyyishtu memehen vechonsim mayim levorot umearot shel rabbim umetakkenin et sidkehen. umesirin et hakkotzin min hadderachim. umoddin et hammikvaot vechol mikve shennimtza chaser margilin lo mayim umashlimin lo shiuro:

Veyotzin sheluche bet din lehafekir et hakkilayim. ufodin et hashshevuyim veet haerchin veet hacharamim veet hahekdeshot. umashkin et hassotot. vesorfin et happara. veorfin et haegla. verotzin eved ivri. umetaharin et hametzora. umetzayyenin al hakkevarot shemmichu geshamim et tziyyunan kede sheyyifreshu mehen hakkohanim. shekkol ellu tzarche rabbim hen:

Vedanim dine mamonot vedine makkot vedine nefashot bammoed. umi shello kibbel alav haddin meshammetin oto bammoed. ucheshem sheddanin bammoed kach kotvin maase bet din vechol haddome lo. ketzad. kotvin haddayyanin iggerot shum sheshshamu levaal chov veiggerot shemmachru bahen limzon haishsha vehabbanot. veshitre chalitza umeunin. vechol haddome lahen middevarim shetztzerichim haddayyanin lechatvam kede sheyyizkerum. kegon taanot baale dinin o devarim shekkibbelu alehen kegon ish peloni neeman alay. o ish peloni yadun li. mi shetztzarich lilvot bammoed velo heemino hammalve beal pe hare ze kotev shetar chov. vechen kotvin gittin vekiddushe nashim veshovrin umattanot. shekkol ellu ketzarche rabbim hen:

Veasur lichtov bammoed afillu sefarim tefillin umezuzot. veen maggihin afillu ot achat besefer haazara mippene shezzo melacha sheenah letzorech hammoed. aval kotev adam tefillin umezuza leatzmo vetove techelet levigdo. veim en lo ma yochal kotev umocher laacherim kede parnasato:
Umuttar lichtov iggerot shel sheelat shalom bammoed. vechotev cheshbonotav umechashshev yetziotav. shekketivot ellu en adam nizhar betikkunan meod venimtzeu kemaase hedyot bimlachot:

Osin kol tzarche hammet bammoed. gozzin searo umechabbesin kesuto veosin lo aron. veim lo hayu lahem nesarim meviin korot venosrin mehem nesarim betzina betoch habbayit. veim haya adam mefursam osin afillu bashshuk. aval en kortin etz min hayyaar linsor mimmennu luchot laaron. veen chotzvin avanim livnot bahen kever:

En roin et hannegaim bammoed shemma yimmatze tame venimtza chaggo nehefach leevel. veen nosin nashim velo meyabbemin bammoed kede shello tishtakkeach simchat hechag besimchat hannissuin. aval machazir et gerushato. umearsin nashim bammoed. uvilvad shello yaase seuddat erusin velo seuddat nissuin. shello yearev simcha acheret besimchat hechag:

En megallechin veen mechabbesin bammoed gezera shemma yashhe adam atzmo letoch hammoed veyavo yom tov harishon vehu menuvval. lefichach kol mi shei efshar lo legalleach ulechabbes beerev yom tov hare ze muttar lechabbes ulegalleach bammoed:

Ketzad. avel shechal shevii shello lihyot beyom tov o shechal lihyot beerev yom tov vahare hu shabbat shei efshar legalleach. vehabba mimmedinat hayyam vehu shello yatza lehitayyel ella lischora vechayyotze bah. vehayyotze mibbet hashshivya umibbet haasurim. umi shehaya menudde velo hittiruhu ella bammoed. umi shennishba shello legalleach veshello lechabbes velo nishal lechacham lehattir nidro ella bammoed hare ellu megallechin umechabbesin bammoed:

Vechullan shehaya lahen penay legalleach kodem haregel velo gillechu asurin. aval hannazir vehametzora shehiggia zeman tiglachtan ben betoch hammoed ben kodem haregel af al pi shehaya lahem penay muttarin legalleach bammoed shello yashhu karbenotehen. vechol hayyotze mittumato letohorato muttar legalleach bammoed. vekatan shennolad ben bammoed ben lifne hammoed muttar legallecho bammoed. veanshe mishmar sheshshalma mishmartan betoch hammoed muttarin legalleach mippene sheanshe mishmar asurin legalleach beshabbat shellahen:

Muttar littol safa bechullo shel moed. velittol tzipparnayim vaafillu bichli. umaaveret haishsha sear mibbet hashshechi umibbet haerva ben bayyad ben bichli. veosa kol tachshiteha bammoed. kochelet ufokeset umaaveret serak al paneha vetofelet atzmah besid vechayyotze bo vehu shettuchal lekappelo bammoed:

Hazzavim vehazzavot vehanniddot vehayyoldot vechol haolim mittuma letohora betoch hammoed hare ellu muttarin lechabbes. umi sheen lo ella chaluk echad hare ze mechabbeso bammoed. mitpechot hayyadayim umitpechot hassefarim umitpechot hasefag hare ellu muttarin lechabbes bammoed. vechen kele pishtan muttar lechabbesan bammoed mippene shetztzerichin kibbus tamid afillu nitkabbesu erev yom tov:

En osin sechora bammoed ben limkor ben liknot. veim haya davar haaved sheeno matzuy tamid leachar hammoed kegon sefinot o shayyarot shebbau o shehem mevakkeshim latzet umachru bezol o lakchu beyoker hare ze muttar liknot o limkor. veen lokchin battim vaavadim uvehema ella letzorech hammoed:

Mochre perot kesut vechelim mochrin betzina letzorech hammoed. ketzad. im hayta hachanut petucha lezavit o lemavoy poteach kedarko. veim hayta petucha lirshut harabbim poteach achat venoel achat. veerev yom tov haacharon shel chag hassukkot motzi umeatter et hashshuk beferot bishvil kevod yom tov. mochre tavlin mochrin kedarkan befarhesya:

Kol sheasur laasoto bammoed eno omer lenachri laasoto. vechol sheasur laasoto bammoed im en lo ma sheyyochal hare ze ose kede parnasato. vechen ose sechora kede parnasato. umuttar leashir liskor poel ani sheen lo ma yochal laasot melacha shehi asura bammoed kede sheyyittol secharo lehitparnes bo. vechen lokchin devarim sheenam letzorech hammoed mippene tzorech hammocher sheen lo ma yochal:

Sochrin hassachir al hammelacha bammoed laasotah leachar hammoed uvilvad shello yishkol veshello yimdod velo yimne kederech shehu ose bechol. nachri shekkibbel kibbolet miyyisrael afillu haya chutz lattechum eno mannicho laasoto bammoed. shehakkol yodin shemmelacha zo shel yisrael veyachshedu oto shehu sachar et hannachri laasot lo bammoed. sheen hakkol yodin hahefresh sheyyesh ben hassachir uven hakkabbelan ulefichach asur:
Mishneh Torah, Rest on a Holiday 8: Neharot hammoshchin min haagammim muttar lehashekot mehen bet hashshelachin bammoed vehu shello pasku. vechen habberechot sheammat hammayim overet benehen muttar lehashekot mehen. vechen berecha shennatfa mibbet hashshelachin vaadayin hi notefet muttar lehashekot mimmenna bet hashshelachin acheret. vehu shello pasak hammayan hammashke bet hashshelachin haelyona:

Aruga shechetzyah namuch vechetzyah gavoah lo yidle mimmakom namuch lehashekot makom gavoah mippene shehu torach gadol. umuttar lidlot mayim lehashekot hayerakot kede leachlan bammoed. veim bishvil leyappotan asur:

En osin ugiyyot beikkere haggefanim kede sheyyitmalleu mayim. veim hayu asuyot venitkalkelu hare ze metakkenam bammoed. vechen ammat hammayim shennitkalkela metakkenin otah bammoed. ketzad. hayta amukka tefach chofer bah ad shishsha. hayta amukka tefachayim maamikah ad shiva. umoshchin et hammayim meilan leilan uvilvad shello yashke et kol hassade. veim hayta sade lacha muttar lehashekot et kullah. umarbitzin et hassade bammoed. shekkol haddevarim haellu en bahen torach yoter:

Zeraim shello shatu millifne hammoed lo yashkem bammoed mippene shehen tzerichin mayim rabbim veyavo lide torach yoter. umuttar lehasev et hannahar mimmakom lemakom veliftoach nahar shennistam. borot shichin umearot shel yachid im haya tzarich lahem chottin otan veshafin et sidkehem aval en chofrin otan lechattechilla. vechonsim letochah mayim af al pi sheeno tzarich lahen. veosin nivrechet bammoed:

Achbarim shehen mafsidin et hailanot tzadin otan bammoed. bisde hailan tzad kedarko. ketzad. chofer vetole hammetzuda. veim haya sade lavan samuch lisde hailan tzadin otan bassade hallavan beshinnuy kede shello yikkansu lisde hailan veyachrivuha. vechetzad tzad, beshinnuy. noetz shippud baaretz umakke bekordom veachar kach menatteko venimtza mekomo guma:

Kotel ginna shennafal bonehu maase hedyot o goder oto bekanim vegome vechayyotze bahen. vechen im asa maake laggag bone oto maase hedyot. aval kotel chatzer shennafal bonehu kedarko. veim haya gohe sotro mippene hassakkana uvonehu kedarko:

Bone adam itztabba leshev o lishon aleha. hatztzir vehatztzinnor vehakkora vehammanul vehammafteach shennishberu metakkenan bammoed kedarko ben beshel barzel ben beshel etz. shezze hefsed gadol hu sheim yaniach happetach patuach udelatot shevurot nimtza meabbed kol ma shebbabbayit. uchevar bearnu kol sheyyesh bo hefsed eno tzarich shinnuy:
En chofrin kever lihyot muchan lemet sheyyamut veen bonin oto. aval im haya asuy hare ze metakkeno bammoed. ketzad. mosif bemiddato o mekatztzer mimmiddato kede sheyyihye nachon leet sheyyikbor bo:

En mefannin et hammet velo et haatzamot mikkever lekever lo mimmechubbad levazuy velo mibbazuy limchubbad. veasur laasot ken leolam bishar hayyamim ella im ken haya mefannehu betoch shello mefannehu bishar hayyamim afillu mimmechubbad levazuy:

En matliin et hailanot velo mazhimin et hannetiot velo megazzemin. aval sachin et hailanot veet happerot shebbahen beshemen veokrin et happishta mippene shehi reuya lachafof bah bammoed. vekotzrin et hakkishshut mippene shehi reuya lehattilah leshechar bammoed. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

En mechannesin et hatztzon laddir kede sheyyezabbelu et hakkarka. shehare hu medayyer sadehu bammoed. veim bau mealehen muttar. veen mesayyein otan veen mosrin lahen shomer lenaer et hatztzon. haya sechir shabbat sechir chodesh sechir shana sechir shavua mesayyein otan vesochrin shomer lenaer et tzonam mimmakom lemakom kede sheyyezabbelu kol hassade. hazzevel shebbechatzer mesallekin oto latztzedadin. veim naasa chatzer kerefet bakar motziin oto laashpa:

Hammashve pene hakkarka im nitkavven letakken makom sheyyaamid bo keri shel tevua o sheyyadush bo muttar. veim nitkavven laavodat haaretz asur. vechen hamelakket etzim mittoch sadehu im letzorech etzim muttar veim letakken hakkarka asur. vechen happotek mayim leginna im nitkavven sheyyikkansu haddagim muttar veim lehashekot haaretz asur. vechen hakkotzetz charayot min haddekel im nitkavven lehaachil labbehema muttar veim nitkavven laavodat hailan asur. umimmaasav yukkar lee ze davar hu mitkavven:

Tannur vechirayim sheefshar sheyivshu veyofe bahen bammoed osin veim lav en osin otan. vben kach uven kach bonin al cheres shel tannur veal hikkira hattefela shellahen umesargin et hammittot. venokrin et harechayim ufotchim lahen ayin umaamidin otan uvonin ammat hammayim shel rechayim:

Zoftin et hechavit kede shello yippased hayyayin. vezoftin et habbakbuk mippene sheen bo torach. vesotmin pi hechavit shel shechar kede shello tippased. umechappin et hakketziot bekash kede shello yovdu. umerakkechin et habbegadim bayyadayim. mippene shehu maase hedyot. aval en osin kishre bet hayyadayim mippene shehu maase umman. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kotztzin tzipparne chamor shel rechayim uvonin evus labbehema. vesus sheyyirkav alav muttar littol tzipparnav ulesarko kede leyappoto. veen marbiin behema bammoed. aval makkizin lah dam. veen monin mimmenna refua. vechol maachalot umashkim sheenan maachal beriim ella lirfua muttar laadam leachlan velishtotan bammoed:

En mefannin mechatzer lechatzer bammoed. velo mikkeura lenaa velo minnaa lichura. aval mefanne hu mibbayit levayit beotah chatzer. umeviin kelim shehen letzorech hammoed mibbet haumman. kegon karim uchesatot utzelochiyyot. aval kelim sheenan letzorech hammoed kegon machresha min hallotesh o tzemer mibbet hatztzabba en meviin. veim en laumman ma yochal noten lo secharo umannichan etzlo. veim eno maamino mannichan babbayit hassamuch lo. veim choshesh lahem shemma yigganvu mefannan lechatzer acheret aval lo yavi leveto ella betzina:

Asur laasot melacha bearve yamim tovim min hammincha ulemala kemo arve shabbatot. vechol haose melacha bahen eno roe siman beracha leolam. vegoarin bo umevattelin oto beal karcho. aval en makkin oto makkat mardut. veen tzarich lomar sheen menaddin oto. chutz meerev happesach achar chatzot shehaose bo melacha achar chatzot menaddin oto. veen tzarich lomar shemmakkin oto makkat mardut im lo nidduhu. lefi sheyyom arbaa asar benisan eno kishar arve yamim tovim mippene sheyyesh bo chagiga ushechitat karban:

Lefichach yom arbaa asar benisan asur baasiyyat melacha middivre sofrim kemo chullo shel moed. vehu kal mechullo shel moed. veeno asur ella mechatzi hayyom ulemala shehu zeman hashshechita. aval mehanetz hachamma ad chatzi hayyom taluy bamminhag. makom shennahagu laasot osin makom shennahagu shello laasot en osin:

Vaafillu bemakom shennahagu laasot lo yatchil battechilla laasot melacha bearbaa asar af al pi shehu yachol legamrah kodem chatzot. ella shalosh ummanuyyot bilvad hen shemmatchilin bahem bemakom shennahagu laasot veosin ad chatzot. veellu hen hachayyatin. vehassapparin. vehakkovsin. aval shear ummanuyyot im hitchil bahen kodem arbaa asar hu sheyyigmor ad chatzot sheen haam tzerichin lishar ummanuyyot tzorech harebe:

Haholech mimmakom sheosin lemakom sheen osin lo yaase bayyishshuv mippene hammachaloket aval ose hu bammidbar. vehaholech mimmakom sheen osin lemakom sheosin lo yaase. notnin alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre makom shehalach lesham. veaf al pi chen lo yitrae bifnehem shehu batel mippene haissur. leolam al yeshanne adam mippene hammachaloket. vechen mi sheddato lachazor limkomo noheg keanshe mekomo ben lehakel ben lehachamir. vehu shello yitrae bifne anshe hammakom shehu bo mippene hammachaloket:

Molichin umeviin kelim mibbet haumman bearbaa asar achar chatzot af al pi sheenan letzorech hammoed. vegorfin zevel mittachat ragle behema umotziim oto laashpa. umoshivin shovachin lattarnegolim. tarnegolet sheyyashva al habbetzim shelosha yamim o yeter umeta moshivin acheret tachteha bearbaa asar kede shello yippasdu habbetzim. uvammoed en moshivin. aval im barcha bammoed meal habbetzim machzirin otah limkomah: seliku lehu hilchot shevitat yom tov
Mishneh Torah, Leavened and Unleavened B:
Kol haochel kezayit chametz befesach mittechillat lel chamishsha asar ad sof yom echad veesrim benisan bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 15)</small> "ki kol ochel chametz venichreta". beshogeg chayyav karban chattat kevua. echad haochel veechad hamemache veshote: 
Hechametz bappesach asur bahanaya shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 3)</small> "lo yeachel chametz" lo yehe bo hetter achila. vehammanniach chametz birshuto befesach af al pi shello achalo over bishne lavin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "lo yerae lecha seor bechol gevulecha" veneemar <small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "seor lo yimmatze bevattechem". veissur hechametz veissur hasseor shebbo machmitzin echad hu: 
Eno loke mishshum lo yerae v<small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "lo yimmatze" ella im ken kana chametz befesach o chimtzo kede sheyyaase bo maase. aval im haya lo chametz kodem happesach uva happesach velo biaro ella hinnicho birshuto af al pi sheavar al shene lavin eno loke min hattora mippene shello asa bo maase. umakkin oto makkat mardut: 
Chametz sheavar alav happesach asur bahanaya leolam. vedavar ze kenas hu middivre sofrim mippene sheavar al bal yerae uval yimmatze asaruhu. afillu hinnicho bishgaga o beones. kede shello yanniach adam chametz birshuto befesach kede sheyyehane bo achar happesach: 
Chametz shennitarev bedavar acher toch happesach ben bemino ben shello bemino hare ze oser bechol shehu. vechametz shel yisrael sheavar alav happesach af al pi shehu asur bahanaya im nitarev ben bemino ben shello bemino hare ze muttar leachlo achar happesach. shello kansu veasru ella bechametz atzmo aval hattaarovet muttar baachila leachar happesach: 
En chayyavin karet ella al achilat atzmo shel chametz aval eruv chametz kegon kutach habbavli veshechar hammadi vechol haddome lahen middevarim shehechametz meorav bahen im achalan befesach loke veen bo karet shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 20)</small> "kol machmetzet lo tochelu". bamme devarim amurim besheachal kezayit chametz betoch hattaarovet bichde achilat shalosh betzim hu shelloke min hattora. aval im en battaarovet kezayit bichde achilat shalosh betzim af al pi sheasur lo leechol im achal eno loke ella makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Haochel min hechametz atzmo befesach kol shehu hare ze asur min hattora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 3)</small> "lo yeachel". veaf al pi chen eno chayyav karet o karban ella al kashshiur shehu kezayit. vehaochel pachot mikkezayit bemezid makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Asur leechol chametz beyom arbaa asar mechatzot hayyom ulemala shehu mittechillat shaa sheviit bayyom. vechol haochel bazzeman hazze loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lo tochal alav chametz". kelomar al karban happesach. kach lamdu mippi hashshemua beferush davar ze lo tochal chametz mishshaa sheruya lishchitat happesach shehu <small>(Shemot 12 6)</small> "ben haarbayim" vehu chatzi hayyom: 
Veasru chachamim leechol chametz mittechillat shaa shishshit kede shello yigga beissur tora. umittechillat shaa shishshit yihye hechametz asur baachila uvahanaya kol shaa shishshit middivre sofrim ushear hayyom mishsheviit ulemala min hattora. shaa chamishit en ochlin bah chametz gezera mishshum yom hameunnan shemma yite ben chamishit leshishshit. veeno asur bahanaya beshaa chamishit. lefichach tolin bah teruma velechem toda vechayyotze bahen mechametz shehu kodesh lo ochlin velo sorfin ad shettaggia shaa shishshit vesorfin hakkol: 
Ha lamadta shemmuttar leechol chametz beyom arbaa asar ad sof shaa reviit. veen ochlin beshaa chamishit aval nehenin bo. vehaochel beshaa shishshit makkin oto makkat mardut. vehaochel mittechillat shaa sheviit loke:

Mitzvat ase min hattora lehashebit hechametz kodem zeman issur achilato shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 15)</small> "bayyom harishon tashbitu seor mibbattechem". umippi hashshemua lamdu shebbarishon ze hu yom arbaa asar. reaya ledavar ze ma shekkatuv battora <small>(Shemot 34 25)</small> "lo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi" kelomar lo tishchat happesach vaadayin hechametz kayyam. ushechitat happesach hu yom arbaa asar achar chatzot: 
Uma hi hashebata zo haamura battora hi sheyyevattel hechametz belibbo veyachashov oto keafar veyasim belibbo sheen birshuto chametz kelal. veshekkol chametz shebbirshuto hare hu keafar uchedavar sheen bo tzorech kelal: 
Umiddivre sofrim lechappes achar hechametz bammachavoot uvachorim velivdok ulehotzio mikkol gevulo. vechen middivre sofrim shebbodkin umashbitin hechametz ballayla mittechillat lel arbaa asar leor hanner. mippene shebballayla kol haam metzuyin babbattim veor hanner yafe livdika. veen kovin midrash besof yom shelosha asar. vechen hechacham lo yatchil likrot beet zo shemma yimmashech veyimmana mibbedikat chametz bitchillat zemanna: 
En bodkin lo leor hallevana velo leor hachamma velo leor haavuka ella leor hanner. bamme devarim amurim bechorim uvemachavoot aval achsadra sheorah rav im bedakah leor hachamma dayyo. veemtza hechatzer eno tzarich bedika mippene shehaofot metzuyim sham vehen ochlin kol chametz sheyyippol sham: 
Chor shebbeemtza habbayit shebben adam lachavero ze bodek ad makom sheyyado maggaat veze bodek ad makom sheyyado maggaat vehashshear mevattelo belibbo. aval chor shebben yisrael leakkum eno bodek kelal shemma yomar haakkum keshafim hu ose li ella mevattelo belibbo vedayyo. vechol makom sheen machnisin bo chametz eno tzarich bedika: 
Chore habbayit hattachtonim vehaelyonim vegag hayyatzia verefet bakar velulin umatben veotzrot yayin veotzrot shemen sheeno mistappek mehen uvet dagim gedolim enan tzerichin bedika ella im ken hichnis lahen chametz. aval otzrot shechar veotzrot yayin shemmistappek mimmennu uvet dagim ketannim uvet haetzim uvet hammureyas vechore habbayit haemtzaim vechayyotze baellu tzerichin bedika shessetaman shemmachnisin lahen chametz. veim yada bevadday shello hichnis sham chametz eno tzarich bedika. ucheshebbodek hammartef bodek mimmennu shete shurot hachitzonot shehen haelyona veshellematta mimmenna: 
En choshshin shemma garra chulda chametz lemakom sheen machnisin bo chametz sheim nachush mibbayit levayit nachush meir leir veen laddavar sof. badak lel arbaa asar vehinniach eser challot umatza tesha hare ze choshesh vetzarich livdok paam sheniyya shehare garra chulda o achbar bevadday: 
Vechen im raa achbar shennichnas labbayit vechametz befiv achar bedika tzarich livdok paam sheniyya af al pi shemmatza perurin beemtza habbayit en omrin kevar achal otah happat bemakom ze vahare happerurin ella choshshin shemma hinnicha bechor o bechallon veillu happerurin sham hayu. ulefichach chozer uvodek. im lo matza kelum hare ze bodek kol habbayit veim matza otah happat shennetalah haachbar venichnas en tzarich bedika: 
Raa tinok shennichnas levayit baduk uveyado kikkar venichnas acharav umatza perurin eno tzarich bedika shechezkato sheachalo veellu happerurin shennaflu mimmennu bishat achila shedderech hattinok lefarer beet achilato veen derech achbar lefarer. veim lo matza perurin kelal tzarich livdok: 
Hinniach tisha tzevurin shel matztza veechad shel chametz uva achbar venatal velo yadanu im chametz o matztza natal venichnas levayit baduk tzarich livdok shekkol hakkavua kemechetza al mechetza: 
Shene tzevurin echad shel chametz veechad shel matztza ushene battim echad baduk veechad sheeno baduk uvau shene achbarim ze natal chametz veze natal matztza veen yadua lee ze bayit nichnas ze shennatal hechametz. vechen shene battim bedukin utzevur echad shel chametz uva achbar venatal veen yadua leeze bayit nichnas. o sheyyada shennichnas leechad mehen venichnas acharav uvadak velo matza kelum o shebbadak umatza kikkar. o shehayu tisha tzevurin shel matztza veechad shel chametz uferash kikkar mehen veen yadua im chametz im matztza uva achbar venatal hakkikkar shepperash venichnas levayit baduk bechol ellu eno tzarich livdok paam sheniyya sheen kan kavua: 
Hinniach hechametz bezavit zo umetzao bezavit acher o shehinniach tesha challot umatza eser. o shebba achbar venatal hechametz vesafek nichnas levayit ze o lo nichnas. bechol ellu tzarich livdok: 
Nichnas achbar levayit vechikkar befiv veyatza achbar mishsham vechikkar befiv omrim hu harishon shennichnas hu haacharon sheyyatza veeno tzarich livdok. haya harishon shennichnas shachor veze sheyyatza lavan tzarich livdok. nichnas achbar vechikkar befiv veyatzta mishsham chulda vechikkar befiha tzarich livdok. yatzat mishsham chulda veachbar vechikkar befiha eno tzarich livdok shezze hakkikkar hu shehaya befi haachbar. nachash shennichnas lechor ufat befiv en chayyav lehavi chabbar lehotzio: 
Kezayit chametz bishme kora mechayyevin oto lehavi sullam lehorido sheppeamim yippol mishsheme kora. haya chametz bevor en mechayyevin oto lehaaloto ella mevattelo belibbo vedayyo: 
Kippat seor sheyyichadah lishiva im tach paneha betit hare zo betela umuttar lekayyemah. batzek shebbesidke haareva im yesh kezayit bemakom echad chayyav levaer. veim lav im haya asuy lechazzek bo shivre haareva o listom bo nekev batel bemiuto veim lav chayyav levaer. hayu bo shene chatzae zetim bishne mekomot vechut shel batzek benehem roin kol sheillu yinnatel hachut nittalin immo chayyav levaer veim lav eno tzarich levaer: 
Bamme devarim amurim baareva aval bevayit af al pi sheim yinnatel hachut en nittalin immo chayyav levaer mippene sheppeamim mekabbetz otan. haya chatzi zayit babbayit vachatzi zayit baaliyya. chatzi zayit babbayit vachatzi zayit baachsadra. chatzi zayit bevayit ze vachatzi zayit bevayit shellifnim mimmennu. hoil veellu hachatzae zetim devukin bakketalim o bakkorot o bakkarkaot eno chayyav levaer ella mevattel belibbo vedayyo: 
Hammaskir bayit setam bearbaa asar hare ze bechezkat baduk veeno tzarich livdok. veim huchzak ze hammaskir shello badak veamru ishsha o katan anu bedaknuhu hare ellu neemanin shehakkol neemanim al biur chametz. vehakkol kesherin livdika vaafillu nashim vaavadim uketannim vehu sheyyihye katan sheyyesh bo daat livdok: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero im ad shello masar lo hammafteach chal arbaa asar al hammaskir livdok. veim mishshemmasar hammafteach chal arbaa asar al hassocher livdok. hammaskir bayit bechezkat shehu baduk venimtza sheeno baduk al hassocher livdok veeno mikkach taut. vaafillu bemakom shebbodkim besachar shehare mitzva hu ose: 
Hamefaresh bayyam vehayyotze beshayyara toch sheloshim yom zakuk livdok. kodem sheloshim yom eno tzarich livdok. veim dato lachazor kodem happesach tzarich livdok veachar kach yetze shemma yachazor erev happesach ben hashshemashot velo yihye lo penay levaer. veim en dato lachazor en tzarich livdok. vechen haose beto otzar. toch sheloshim yom zakuk livdok veachar kach kones otzaro letocho. kodem sheloshim yom im dato lefannoto kodem happesach tzarich livdok veachar kach osehu otzar. veim en dato lefannoto kodem happesach eno tzarich livdok:

Keshevodek adam umechappes belele arbaa asar motzi et hechametz min hachorim umin hammachavoot umin hazzaviyyot umekabbetz hakkol umannicho bemakom echad ad techillat shaa shishshit bayyom umevaaro. veim ratza levaaro belele arbaa asar mevaaro:

Hechametz shemmanniach belele arbaa asar kede sheyyochal mimmennu lemachar ad arba shaot eno mannicho mefuzzar umeforad bechol makom ella matznio bichli o bezavit yedua veyizzaher bo. sheim lo nizhar bo umetzao chaser tzarich lechappes acharav velivdok paam acheret shemma geraruhu haachbarim:

Chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat bodkin et hechametz belele erev shabbat shehu lel shelosha asar umanniach min hechametz kede leechol mimmennu ad arba shaot beyom hashshabbat. umannicho bemakom mutzna vehashshear mevaaro millifne hashshabbat. veim nishar min hechametz beyom hashshabbat achar arba shaot mevattelo vechofe alav keli ad motzae yom tov harishon umevaaro:

Hayu lo kikkarot rabbot shel teruma vetzarich lesarfah erev shabbat lo yearev hattehora im hattemea veyisrof ella soref temea leatzmah utehora leatzmah uteluya leatzmah. umanniach min hattehora kede leechol ad arba shaot beyom hashshabbat bilvad:

Mi sheshshachach o hezid velo badak belel arbaa asar bodek arbaa asar beshacharit. lo badak beshacharit bodek bishat habbiur. lo badak bishat habbiur bodek betoch hechag. avar haregel velo badak bodek achar haregel kede sheyyevaer ma sheyyimtza mechametz sheavar alav happesach mippene shehu asur bahanaya:

Keshebbodek hechametz belele arbaa asar o beyom arbaa asar o betoch haregel mevarech kodem sheyyatchil livdok baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al biur chametz. uvodek umechappes bechol hammekomot shemmachnisin lahem chametz kemo shebbearnu. veim badak leachar haregel eno mevarech:

Uchesheggomer livdok im badak belel arbaa asar o beyom arbaa asar kodem shesh shaot tzarich levattel kol chametz shennishar birshuto veeno roehu. veyomar kol chametz sheyyesh birshuti shello reitiv hare hu batel vahare hu keafar. aval im badak mittechillat shaa shishshit ulemala eno yachol levattel shehare eno birshuto shekkevar neesar bahanaya:

Lefichach im lo bittel kodem shesh umishshesh shaot ulemala matza chametz shehaya dato alav vehaya belibbo ushechacho bishat habbiur velo biaro hare ze avar al <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "lo yerae" v <small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "lo yimmatze" shehare lo bier velo bittel. veen habbittul atta moil lo kelum lefi sheeno birshuto vehakkatuv asahu keillu hu birshuto lechayyevo mishshum lo yerae velo yimmatze. vechayyav levaaro bechol et sheyyimtzaennu. veim metzao beyom tov kofe alav keli ad laerev umevaaro. veim shel hekdesh hu eno tzarich lichpot alav keli shehakkol porshin mimmennu:

Mi sheyyatza mibbeto kodem sheat habbiur laasot mitzva o leechol seudda shel mitzva kegon seuddat erusin venissuin venizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betoch beto. im yachol lachazor ulevaer velachazor lemitzvato yachazor veim lav yevattel belibbo. yatza lehatztzil miyyad haggayis min hannahar min haddeleka umin hammappolet yevattel belibbo vedayyo. yatza letzorech atzmo venizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betoch beto yachazor miyyad. vead kamma hu chozer ad kevetza. haya pachot mikkevetza mevattelo belibbo vedayyo:

Mi shehinniach issa megulgelet betoch beto veyatza venizkar achar sheyyatza vehu yoshev lifne rabbo vehaya yare shemma tachamitz kodem sheyyavo hare ze mevattelo belibbo kodem shettachamitz. aval im hechmitza en habbittul moil kelum ella kevar avar al <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "lo yerae" v <small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "lo yimmatze" vechayyav levaer miyyad kesheyyachazor leveto:

Ketzad biur chametz. sorfo o porer vezore laruach o zorko layyam. veim haya hechametz kashe veen hayyam mechattecho bimhera hare ze mefarro veachar kach zorko layyam. chametz shennafla alav mappolet venimtza alav afar shelosha tefachim o yoter hare hu kimvoar vetzarich levattel belibbo im adayin lo nichnesa shaa shishshit. netano leakkum kodem shaa shishshit eno tzarich levaer. veim serafo kodem shaa shishshit hare ze muttar lehanot bappechamin shello betoch happesach. aval im serafo mishshaa shishshit ulemala hoil vehu asur bahanaya hare ze lo yassik bo tannur vechirayim velo yofe bo velo yevashshel. veim bishshel o afa otah happat veoto hattavshil asur bahanaya. vechen happechamin shello asurin bahanaya hoil vesorfo achar shenneesar bahanaya:

Katuv battora <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> "lo yerae lecha chametz". yachol im taman oto o hifkid oto beyad akkum lo yihye over talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "seor lo yimmatze bevattechem" afillu hifkido o hitmino. yachol lo yihye over ella im ken haya hechametz beveto aval im haya rachok mibbeto bassade o beir acheret lo yihye over talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "bechol gevulecha" bechol reshutecha. yachol yehe chayyav levaer mershuto chametz shel akkum o shel hekdesh talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "lo yerae lecha" shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah:

Ha lamadta shehechametz shel yisrael im henicho birshuto afillu tamun vaafillu beir acheret vaafillu mufkad beyad akkum hare ze over mishshum <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "lo yerae" v<small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "lo yimmatze". chametz shel hekdesh o shel akkum shehaya etzel yisrael afillu haya immo babbayit hare ze muttar mippene sheeno shello. vaafillu haya shel ger toshav sheyyad yisrael sholetet alav en kofin oto lehotzi hechametz mershuto befesach. aval tzarich laasot mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim bifne chametzo shel akkum shemma yavo lehistappek mimmennu. aval shel hekdesh eno tzarich mippene shehakkol porshin min hahekdesh kede shello yavou lide meila:

Akkum shehifkid chametzo etzel yisrael im kibbel alav yisrael acharayut sheim avad o nignav yeshallem lo damav hare ze chayyav levaaro hoil vekibbel alav acharayut naasa keshello. veim lo kibbel alav acharayut muttar lekayyemo etzlo umuttar leechol mimmennu achar happesach shebbirshut haakkum hu:

Akkum annas shehifkid chametzo etzel yisrael im yodea hayyisrael sheim avad o nignav mechayyevo leshallemo vechofehu veonso leshallem af al pi shello kibbel acharayut hare ze chayyav levaaro. shehare nechshav keillu hu shello mippene shemmechayyevo haannas beachrayuto:

Yisrael shehirhin chametzo etzel haakkum im amar lo im lo heveti lecha maot mikkan vead yom peloni kene chametz ze meachshav hare ze birshut haakkum veoto hechametz muttar leachar happesach. vehu sheyyihye oto zeman shekkava lo kodem happesach. veim lo amar lo kene meachshav nimtza oto hechametz keillu hu pikkadon etzel haakkum veasur bahanaya leachar happesach:

Yisrael veakkum shehayu bain bisfina vehaya chametz beyad yisrael vehiggia shaa chamishit hare ze mochro leakkum o notno lo bemattana vechozer velokcho mimmennu achar happesach. uvilvad sheyyittenennu lo mattana gemura:

Omer yisrael leakkum ad sheatta lokeach bemane bo vekach bematayim. ad sheatta lokeach meakkum bo vekach miyyisrael shemma etztarech veekkach mimmecha achar happesach. aval lo yimkor velo yitten lo al tenay. veim asa ken hare ze over al bal yerae uval yimmatze:

Taarovet chametz ovrin aleha mishshum bal yerae uval yimmatze. kegon hammureyas vechutach habbavli veshechar hammadi sheosin oto min hakkemach. vechol kayyotze baellu middevarim hanneechalim. aval davar sheyyesh bo taarovet chametz veeno rauy laachila hare ze muttar lekayyemo befesach:

Ketzad. arevat haabbedanin shennatan letochah kemach veorot afillu netano shaa achat kodem habbiur hare ze muttar lekayyemo. veim lo natan haorot venatan hakkemach kodem shelosha yamim lishat habbiur muttar lekayyemo shehare nifsad vehivish. toch shelosha yamim chayyav levaer:
Vechen hakkilor vehartiyya vehaispelanit vehatteriak shennatan letochan chametz muttar lekayyeman befesach shehare nifseda tzurat hechametz:

Happat atzmah sheippesha venifsela milleechol hakkelev vmlugema shennisrecha eno tzarich levaer. begadim shekkibbesu otan bechelev chitta vechen neyarot sheddibbeku otan bechametz vechol kayyotze baze muttar lekayyeman befesach veen bahen mishshum <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "lo yerae" v<small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "lo yimmatze" sheen tzurat hechametz omedet:

Davar shennitarev bo chametz veeno maachol leadam kelal. o sheeno maachal kol adam kegon hatteriak vechayyotze bo af al pi shemmuttar lekayyemo asur leachlo ad achar happesach. veaf al pi sheen bo min hechametz ella kol shehu hare ze asur leachlo:

En asur mishshum chametz befesach ella chameshet mine dagan bilvad. vehem shene mine chittim shehen hachitta vehakkussemet. ushelosha mine hasseorim shehen hasseora veshibbolet shual vehashshippon. aval kitniyyot kegon orez vedochan ufolim vaadashim vechayyotze bahen en bahen mishshum chametz ella afillu lash kemach orez vechayyotze bo berotchin vechissahu bivgadim ad shennitpach kemo batzek shehechemitz hare ze muttar baachila sheen ze chimmutz ella serachon:

Chameshet mine dagan ellu im lashan beme perot bilvad belo shum mayim leolam en bain lide chimmutz ella afillu hinnichan kol hayyom ad shennitpach habbatzek muttar baachila [3.] sheen me perot machmitzin ella masrichin. ume perot hen kegon yayin vechalav udevash veshemen zayit ume tappuchim ume rimmonim vechol kayyotze bahen mishshear yenot ushemanim umashkin. vehu shello yitarev bahen shum mayim baolam. veim nitarev bahen mayim kol shehu hare ellu machmitzin:

En mevashshelin chittim bemayim kegon rifot velo kemach kegon levivot. veim bishshel hare ze chametz gamur vehu sheyyitbakkeu battavshil. en kolin et habbatzek beshemen al hammachavat. aval mevashshelin et happat veet hakkemach hakkaluy. veim hirtiach hammayim harebe veachar kach hishlich letochan hakkemach hare ze muttar mippene shehu mitbashshel miyyad kodem sheyyachmitz. uchevar nahagu beshinar uvisfarad uvechol hammaarav leesor davar ze gezera shemma lo yartiach hammayim yafe yafe:
Muttar levashshel haddagan o hakkemach beme perot. vechen batzek shellasho beme perot im bishshelo beme perot o kalahu al hammachavat beshemen hare ze muttar shemme perot enan machmitzin:

Karmel shemmehavhavin oto baur vetochanin oto en mevashshelin et hakkemach shello bemayim shemma lo nikla baur yafe venimtza machamitz keshemmevashshelin oto. vechen keshemmollin hakkederot hachadashot en mevashshelin bahen ella matztza afuya shechazru vetachanu otah aval kemach kali asur shemma lo kalahu yafe veyavo lide chimmutz:

En bollin et hasseorin bemayim befesach mippene shehen rafin umachmitzin bimhera. veim balal im rafu kede sheim hinnichan al pi habbiv sheofin alav hachallot yitbakkeu hare ellu asurin. veim lo higgiu lerifyon ze hare ellu muttarin:

Hachittim muttar livlol otan bemayim kede lehasir subban vetochanin otan miyyad kederech shettochanin hassolet. uchevar nahagu kol yisrael beshinar uveeretz hatztzevi uvisfarad uveare hammaarav shello yivlelu hachittim bemayim gezera shemma yishhu veyachamitzu:

Tavshil shenitbashshel venimtzeu bo seorim o chittim im nitbakkeu hare kol hattavshil asur shehare nitarev bo hechametz. veim lo nitbakkeu motziin otan vesorfan veochlin shear hattavshil. sheen haddagan shennivlal velo nitbakkea chametz gamur shel tora. veeno ella middivre sofrim:

Mishshum shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 17)</small> "ushemartem et hammatztzot" kelomar hizzaharu bammatztza veshimru otah mikkol tzad chimmutz. lefichach amru chachamim tzarich adam lizzaher bedagan sheochel mimmennu bappesach shello yavo alav mayim achar shenniktzar ad shello yihye bo shum chimmutz. dagan shennitba bannahar o shennafal alav mayim keshem sheasur leachlo kach asur lekayyemo ella mochro leyisrael umodio kede sheyyochlennu kodem happesach. veim mecharo lenachri kodem happesach mocher meat lechol echad veechad kede sheyyichle kodem happesach shemma yachazor hannachri veyimkerennu leyisrael:
Dagan shennafal alav delef kol zeman shehu tored tippa achar tippa afillu kol hayyom kullo eno ba lide chimmutz. aval kesheyyippasek im nishtaha kashshiur hare ze asur:

En lashin befesach issa gedola shemma tachamitz ella keshiur challa bilvad. veen lashin lo bechammin velo bechamme chamma. velo bemayim shennishavu bo bayyom ella bemayim shellanu. veim avar velash beechad mikkol ellu hare happat asura:

Lo teshev ishsha tachat hashshemesh vetalush. velo tachat harakia beyom heavim afillu bemakom sheen hashshemesh zorachat bo. velo taniach et haissa vetitassek bedavar acher. veim hayta lasha veofa tzericha shene kelim shel mayim. echad shemmekattefet bo veechad shemmetzannenet bo yadeha. veim avra velasha tachat hashshemesh o shello tzinnena yadeha o sheasta issa yeter mishshiur challa happat mutteret. vechamma shiur challa kemo shalosh vearbaim betzim vechomesh betza keguf habbetza habbenonit lo kemishkalah:

Kol zeman sheadam osek babbatzek afillu kol hayyom kullo eno ba lide chimmutz. veim higbiah yado vehenicho veshaha habbatzek ad shehiggia lehashemia hakkol bizman sheadam makke beyado alav kevar hechmitz veyissaref miyyad. veim en kolo nishma im shaha kede sheyyehallech adam mil kevar hechmitz veyissaref miyyad. vechen im hichsifu panav keadam sheamdu saarotav hare ze asur leachlo veen chayyavin alav karet:
Hayu shete issot shehigbihu hayyad mehen nilloshot beet achat venishtahu. haachat mehen yesh lah kol vehaacheret en lah kol. shetehen yissarfu vahare hen chametz gamur:

En osin serikin hametzuyyarin befesach mippene shehaishsha shoha alehen umitchammetzin beet asiyyatan. lefichach hannachtomin muttarin laasotam mippene shehen bekiin beummanutan umemaharim laasotam. aval baale battim asurim vaafillu tzaru otan bidfus. shemma yavou acherim laasoto shello bidfus veyishhu baasiyyatan veyachamitzu:
Mayim sherochatzin bahen hayyadayim vehaareva achar shellashin vechen mayim shemmishtammeshin bahen bishat lisha hare ze yishpoch otan bimkom midron kede shello yitkabbetzu bemakom echad veyachmitz:

En shorin et hammursan umannichin lifne hattarnegolin shemma yachmitz. aval choltin lahen hammursan berotchin umannichin lifnehen. uchevar nahagu rov haolam shello lachalot gezera shemma lo yartiach hammayim yafe:

Umuttar lalush letarnegolin mursan o kemach umaachilan miyyad o noten lifnehen vehu omed alehen ad shello yashhe lifnehen kede hilluch mil. vechol zeman shehen menakkerin bo o shehu mehappech beyado eno machamitz. uchesheyyifseku milleechol yishtof hakkeli bemayim veyishpoch bimkom midron:

Lo tishre ishsha mursan shettolich beyadah lammerchatz. aval shafa al besarah yavesh. velo yilos adam chittin veyitten al makkato mippene shehen machamitzot. en notnin et hakkemach letoch hacharoset veim natan yishshafech miyyad mippene shehu memaher lehachamitz. veen notnin et hakkemach letoch hachardal veim natan yochal miyyad:

Muttar litten hattavlin vehashshumshemin vehaketztzach vechayyotze bahen letoch habbatzek. vechen muttar lalush haissa bemayim veshemen o devash vechalav o lekattef bahen. uvayyom harishon asur lalush ulekattef ella bemayim bilvad. lo mishshum chametz ella kede sheyyihye <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lechem oni". uvayyom harishon bilvad hu shetztzarich lihyot zichron lechem oni:

Kol keli cheres shennishtammesh bahen chametz betzonen muttar lehishtammesh bahen matztza betzonen. chutz mikkeli shemmannichin bo et hasseor ucheli shemmannichin bo charoset mippene shechimmutzo kashe. vechen arevot shellashin bahen hechametz umannichin oto sham ad sheyyachmitz hare hen kevet seor veen mishtammeshin bahen befesach:
Biv shel cheres sheofin alav challot chametz kol hashshana kullah en ofin alav matztza befesach. veim milleo gechalim vehissik makom shehaya mevashshel bo hechametz muttar levashshel alav matztza:

Kele mattachot uchele avanim shennishtammesh bahen chametz berotchin bichli rishon kegon kederot veilpasin. noten otan letoch keli gadol shel mayim umemalle alehen mayim umartichan betocho ad sheyyifletu veachar kach shotef otan betzonen umishtammesh bahen bematztza. vechen hassakkinin martiach et hallahav veet hannitztzav bichli rishon veachar kach mishtammesh bahen bematztza:

Kele mattachot vaavanim uchele etzim shennishtammesh bahen chametz bichli sheni kegon kearot vechosot noten otan letoch keli gadol venoten alehen mayim rotchin umannichan betocho ad sheyyiflotu veachar kach shotfan umishtammesh bahen bematztza:

Kol keli cheres shennishtammesh bahen chametz bechammin ben keli rishon kegon kederot. ben keli sheni kegon kearot. ben shehayu meshuchin veshuin baavar sheosin otan keen zechuchit. ben shehayu cheres kema shehen. en mishtammeshin bahen bematztza ella mannichan leachar happesach umevashshel bahen:

Keli rishon sheratza lehareticho velo matza keli acher gadol mimmennu kede lehareticho betocho hare ze makkif lo safa shel tit al sefato mibbachutz umemalleehu mayim ad sheyyigberu hammayim al sefato umartiach hammayim betocho vedayyo veachar kach shotef oto umishtammesh bo bematztza:

Mitzvat ase min hattora leechol matztza belel chamishsha asar shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 18)</small> "baerev tochlu matztzot". bechol makom uvechol zeman. velo tala achila zo bekarban happesach ella zo mitzva bifne atzmah umitzvatah kol hallayla. aval bishar haregel achilat matztza reshut ratza ochel matztza ratza ochel orez o dochan o kelayot o perot. aval belel chamishsha asar bilvad chova. umishsheachal kezayit yatza yede chovato:

Bala matztza yatza. bala maror lo yatza. bala matztza umaror keechad yede matztza yatza yede maror lo yatza. shehammaror kitfela lammatztza. kerachan besiv vechayyotze bo uvelaan af yede matztza lo yatza:

Achal matztza belo kavvana kegon sheanasuhu akkum o listim leechol yatza yede chovato. achal kezayit matztza vehu nichpe beet shetuto veachar kach nitrappe chayyav leechol achar shennitrappe. lefi sheotah achila hayta beshaa shehaya patur mikkol hammitzvot:

En adam yotze yede chovat achilat matztza ella im ken achalah meechad mechameshet hamminin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot". devarim habbaim lide chimmutz im achalan matztza yatza bahen yede chovato aval shear devarim kegon orez vedochan vekitniyyot en yotze bahen yede matztza lefi sheen bahen chametz:

Haose issa min hachittim umin haorez im yesh bah taam dagan yotze bah yede chovato. issat hakkelavim bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna yotze bah yede chovato. en haroim ochlin mimmenna eno yotze bah sheen zo meshummeret leshem matztza. matztza shellashah beme perot yotze bah yede chovato befesach. aval en lashin otah beyayin o beshemen o chalav mishshum <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lechem oni" kemo shebbearnu. veim lash veachal lo yatza yede chovato. en yotzin lo befat mursan velo befat subbin. aval lash hu et hakkemach bassubbin shello uvemuresano veosehu pat veyotze bah yede chovato. vechen pat solet nekiyya beyoter hare zo mutteret veyotze bah yede chovato befesach veen omrin bah en ze lechem oni:

Echad matztza shenneefet betannur o beilpas. ben shehidbik habbatzek bailpas veachar kach hirtiach ben shehirtiach veachar kach hidbik afillu afaah bakkarka hare ze yotze bah yede chovato. vechen im lo naafet afiyya gemura yotzin bah. vehu shello yihyu chutin shel batzek nimshachin mimmenna beet shepporsah. veyotzin berakik hashsharuy vehu shello nimmoach. aval matztza shebbishshelah eno yotze bah yede chovato baachilatah shehare en bah taam pat:

En adam yotze yede chovato baachilat matztza shehi asura lo kegon sheachal bo tevel o maaser rishon shello nittela terumato o sheggezalah. ze hakkelal kol shemmevarchin alav birkat hammazon yotze bo yede chovato vechol sheen mevarchin alav birkat hammazon en yotze bo yede chovato:

Hakkohanim yotzin bechalla uvitruma af al pi shehi matztza sheenah reuya lechol adam. vechen yotzin bematztza shel maaser sheni birushalayim. aval en yotzin bematztza shel bikkurim afillu birushalayim mippene shehabbikkurim en lahem hetter bechol hammoshavot. umaaser sheni efshar sheyyippade veyeachel bechol makom. vechatuv <small>(Shemot 12 20)</small> "bechl moshvotechem tochlu matztzot" matztza haruya leheachel bechol hammoshavot hu sheyyotzin bah yede chova:

Challot toda urekike nazir sheasu otan leatzman en yotzin bahen shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 17)</small> "ushemartem et hammatztzot" matztza hammishtammeret leinyan matztza bilvad hu sheyyotzin bah aval zo mishtammeret leinyan hazzevach. veim asaan limkor bashshuk hare ze yotze bah yede chovato. shehaose limkor bashshuk dato sheim lo yimmachru yochal otan venimtza bishat asiyyatan shemaran leshem matztza:

Hakkol chayyavin baachilat matztza afillu nashim vaavadim. katan sheyyachol leechol pat mechannechin oto bemitzvot umaachilin oto kezayit matztza. chole o zaken sheeno yachol leechol shorin lo rakik bemayim umaachilin oto vehu shello nimmoach:

Middivre sofrim sheen maftirin achar matztza kelum vaafillu kelayot veegozim vechayyotze bahen. ella af al pi sheachal matztza veachal achareha maachalot acherot uferot vechayyotze bahen chozer veochel kezayit matztza baacharona ufosek:

Asru chachamim leechol matztza beerev happesach kede sheyyihye hekker laachilatah baerev. umi sheachal matztza beerev happesach makkin oto makkat mardut ad shettetze nafsho. vechen asur leechol erev happesach mikkodem hammincha kimat. kede sheyyikkanes laachilat matztza betaava. aval ochel hu meat perot o yerakot velo yemalle kereso mehen. vachachamim harishonim hayu marivin atzman erev happesach kede leechol matztza betaava veyihyu matztzot chavivot alav. aval bishar arve shabbetot o arve yamim tovim ochel veholech ad shettechshach:

Mitzvat ase shel tora lesapper benissim veniflaot shennaasu laavotenu bemitzrayim belel chamishsha asar benisan shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 3)</small> "zachor et hayyom hazze asher yetzatem mimmitzrayim" kemo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 8)</small> "zachor et yom hashshabbat". uminnayin shebbelel chamishsha asar talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 13 8)</small> "vehiggadta levincha bayyom hahu lemor baavur ze" beshaa sheyyesh matztza umaror munnachim lefanecha. veaf al pi sheen lo ben. afillu chachamim gedolim chayyavim lesapper bitziat mitzrim vechol hammaarich bidvarim sheeru veshehayu hare ze meshubbach:

Mitzva lehodia labbanim vaafillu lo shaalu shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 8)</small> "vehiggadta levincha". lefi dato shel ben aviv melammedo. ketzad. im haya katan o tippesh omer lo beni kullanu hayinu avadim kemo shifcha zo o kemo eved ze bemitzrayim uvallayla hazze pada otanu hakkadosh baruch hu vayyotzienu lecherut. veim haya habben gadol vechacham modio ma sheera lanu bemitzrayim venissim shennaasu lanu al yede moshe rabbenu hakkol lefi dato shel ben:

Vetzarich laasot shinnuy ballayla hazze kede sheyyiru habbanim veyishalu veyomru ma nishtanna hallayla hazze mikkol hallelot ad sheyyashiv lahem veyomar lahem kach vechach era vechach vechach haya. vechetzad meshanne. mechallek lahem kelayot veegozim veokrim hashshulchan millifnehem kodem sheyyochlu vechotfin matztza ze miyyad ze vechayyotze bidvarim haellu. en lo ben ishto shoalto. en lo ishsha shoalin ze et ze ma nishtanna hallayla hazze. vaafillu hayu kullan chachamim. haya levaddo shoel leatzmo ma nishtanna hallayla hazze:

Vetzarich lehatechil bignut ulesayyem beshevach. ketzad. matchil umesapper shebbattechilla hayu avotenu bime terach umillefanav kofrim vetoin achar hahevel verodfin achar avodat elilim. umesayyem bedat haemet shekkervanu hammakom lo vehivdilanu mehaummot vekervanu leyichudo. vechen matchil umodia sheavadim hayinu lefaro bemitzrayim vechol haraa sheggemalanu umesayyem bannissim uvanniflaot shennaasu lanu uvecherutenu. vehu sheyyidrosh mearammi oved avi" <small>(Devarim 26 5)</small> ad sheyyigmor kol happarasha. vechol hammosif umaarich bidrash parasha zo hare ze meshubbach:

Kol mi shello amar shelosha devarim ellu belel chamishsha asar lo yatza yede chovato veellu hen. pesach matztza umaror. pesach al shum sheppasach hammakom al batte avotenu bemitzrayim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 27)</small> "vaamartem zevach pesach hu laAdonai" vegomer. maror al shum shemmerru hammitzriyyim et chayye avotenu bemitzrayim. matztza al shem shennigalu. udevarim haellu kullan nikrain haggada:

Bechol dor vador chayyav adam lehareot et atzmo keillu hu beatzmo yatza atta mishshibud mitzrayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 23)</small> "veotanu hotzi mishsham" vegomer. veal davar ze tzivva hakkadosh baruch hu battora vezacharta ki eved hayita kelomar keillu atta beatzmecha hayita eved veyatzata lecherut venifdeta:

Lefichach keshessoed adam ballayla hazze tzarich leechol velishtot vehu mesev derech cherut. vechol echad veechad ben anashim ben nashim chayyav lishtot ballayla hazze arbaa kosot shel yayin. en pochatin lo mehem. vaafillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka lo yifchatu lo mearbaa kosot. shiur kol kos mehen reviit:

Afillu ani shebbeyisrael lo yochal ad sheyyasev. ishsha enah tzericha hasiva. veim ishsha chashuva hi tzericha hasiva. uven etzel aviv vehashshammash bifne rabbo tzerichin hasiva. aval talmid bifne rabbo eno mesev ella im ken natan lo rabbo reshut. vahasivat yamin enah hasiva. vechen hammesev al arpo o al panav en zo hasiva. veematay tzerichin hasiva bishat achilat kezayit matztza uvishtiyyat arbaa kosot haellu. ushear achilato ushetiyyato im hesev hare ze meshubbach veim lav eno tzarich:

Arbaa kosot haellu tzarich limzog otan kede shettihye shetiyya areva hakkol lefi hayyayin ulefi daat hashshote. velo yifchot bearbatan merviit yayin chay. shata arbaa kosot ellu miyyayin sheeno mazug yatza yede arbaa kosot velo yatza yede cherut. shata arbaa kosot mezugin bevat achat yede cherut yatza yede arbaa kosot lo yatza. veim shata mikkol kos mehen rubbo yatza:

Kol kos vechos mearbaa kosot hallalu mevarech alav beracha bifne atzmah. vechos rishon omer alav kiddush hayyom. kos sheni kore alav et hahaggada. kos shelishi mevarech alav birkat hammazon. kos revii gomer alav et hahallel umevarech alav birkat hashshir. uven hakkosot haellu im ratza lishtot shote. ben shelishi lirvii eno shote:

Hacharoset mitzva middivre sofrim zecher lattit shehayu ovdin bo bemitzrayim. vechetzad osin otah. lokchin temarim o gerogarot o tzimmukin vechayyotze bahen vedorsin otan venotnin letochan chometz umetabbelin otan betavlin kemo tit beteven umeviin otah al hashshulchan belele happesach:

Achilat maror enah mitzva min hattora bifne atzmah ella teluya hi baachilat happesach. shemmitzvat ase achat leechol besar happesach al matztza umerorim. umiddivre sofrim leechol hammaror levaddo belayil ze afillu en sham karban pesach:

Merorim haamurim battora hen hachazeret vehoolashin vehattamcha vehacharchevina vehammaror. kol echad mechameshet mine yarak ellu nikra maror. veim achal meechad mehen o mechamishshetan kezayit yatza vehu sheyyehu lachin. veyotzin bekelach shellahen afillu yavesh. veim shelakan o kevashan o bishshelan en yotzin bahen:

Seder asiyyat mitzvot ellu belel chamishsha asar kach hu. battechilla mozgin kos lechol echad veechad umevarech bore peri haggafen veomer alav kiddush hayyom uzeman veshote. veachar kach mevarech al netilat yadayim venotel yadav. umeviin shulchan aruch vealav maror veyarak acher umatztza vacharoset vegufo shel keves happesach uvesar chagiga shel yom arbaa asar. uvazzeman hazze meviin al hashshulchan shene mine basar echad zecher lappesach veechad zecher lachagiga:

Matchil umevarech bore peri haadama velokeach yarak umetabbel oto bacharoset veochel kezayit hu vechol hamesubbin immo kol echad veechad en ochel pachot mikkezayit. veachar kach okrin hashshulchan millifne kore hahaggada levaddo. umozgin hakkos hashsheni vechan habben shoel. veomer hakkore ma nishtanna hallayla hazze mikkol hallelot shebbechol hallelot en anu matbilin afillu paam achat vehallayla hazze shete peamim. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin chametz umatztza vehallayla hazze kullo matztza. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin besar tzali shaluk umevushshal vehallayla hazze kullo tzali. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin shear yerakot vehallayla hazze merorim. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin ben yoshvin ben mesubbin vehallayla hazze kullanu mesubbin:
Bazzeman hazze eno omer vehallayla hazze kullo tzali sheen lanu karban. umatchil bignut vekore ad sheggomer derash parashat <small>(Devarim 26 5)</small> "arammi oved avi" kullah:

Umachazir hashshulchan lefanav veomer pesach ze sheanu ochlin al shem sheppasach hammakom al batte avotenu bemitzrayim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 27)</small> "vaamartem zevach pesach hu laAdonai". umagbiah hammaror beyado veomer maror ze sheanu ochlin al shem shemmerru hammitzriyyim et chayye avotenu bemitzrayim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 1 14)</small> "vaymarru et chayyehem". umagbiah hammatztza beyado veomer matztza zo sheanu ochlin al shem shello hispik betzekam shel avotenu lehachamitz ad shennigla alehem hakkadosh baruch hu ugealam miyyad shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 39)</small> "vayyofu et habbatzek asher hotziu mimmitzrayim" vechulei. uvazzeman hazze omer pesach shehayu avotenu ochlin bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam al shem sheppasach hakkadosh baruch hu al batte avotenu vechulei:

Veomer lefichach anu chayyavin lehodot lehallel leshabbeach lefaer lehadder leromem legaddel ulenatztzeach lemi sheasa laavotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu vehotzianu meavdut lecherut miyyagon lesimcha umeafela leor gadol venomar lefanav haleluyah. <small>(Tehillim 113 1)</small> "haleluyah halelu avde Adonai" vegomer ad <small>(Tehillim 114 8)</small> "challamish lemayeno mayim". vechotem baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher gealanu vegaal et avotenu mimmitzrayim vehiggianu lallayla hazze leechol bo matztza umerorim. uvazzeman hazze mosif ken Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu yaggienu lammoadim velirgalim acherim habbaim likratenu leshalom semechim bevinyan irecha vesasim baavodatecha venochal sham min hazzevachim umin happesachim sheyyaggia damam al kir mizbachacha leratzon venode lecha shir chadash al geullatenu veal pedut nafshenu baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael. umevarech bore peri haggafen veshote hakkos hashsheni:

Veachar kach mevarech al netilat yadayim venotel yadav shenit shehare hissiach dato bishat keriat hahaggada. velokeach shene rekikin vecholek echad mehen umanniach parus letoch shalem umevarech hammotzi lechem min haaretz. umippene ma eno mevarech al shete kikkarot kishar yamim tovim mishshum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lechem oni" ma darko shel ani bifrusa af kan bifrusa. veachar kach korech matztza umaror keachat umetabbel bacharoset umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al achilat matztzot umerorim veochlan. veim achal matztza bifne atzmah umaror bifne atzmo mevarech al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo:

Veachar kach mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al achilat hazzevach veochel mibbesar chagigat arbaa asar techilla. umevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al achilat happesach veochel miggufo shel pesach. velo birkat happesach poteret shel zevach velo shel zevach poteret shel pesach:

Bazzeman hazze sheen sham karban, achar shemmevarech hammotzi lechem chozer umevarech al achilat matztza. umetabbel matztza bacharoset veochel. vechozer umevarech al achilat maror umetabbel maror bacharoset veochel. velo yashhe oto bacharoset shemma yevattel taamo. vezo mitzva middivre sofrim. vechozer vechorech matztza umaror umetabbel bacharoset veochlan belo beracha zecher lammikdash:

Veachar kach nimshach basseudda veochel kol ma shehu rotze leechol veshote kol ma shehu rotze lishtot. uvaacharona ochel mibbesar happesach afillu kezayit veeno toem acharav kelal. uvazzeman hazze ochel kezayit matztza veeno toem achareha kelum. kede sheyyihye hefsek seuddato vetaam besar happesach o hammatztza befiv sheachilatan hi hammitzva:

Veachar kach notel yadav umevarech birkat hammazon al kos shelishi veshotehu. veachar kach mozeg kos revii vegomer alav et hahallel. veomer alav birkat hashshir vehi yehallucha Adonai kol maasecha vechulei. umevarech bore peri haggafen veeno toem achar kach kelum kol hallayla chutz min hammayim. veyesh lo limzog kos chamishi velomar alav hallel haggadol me<small>(Tehillim 136 1)</small> "hodu laAdonai ki tov" ad <small>(Tehillim 137 1)</small> "al naharot bavel". vechos ze eno chova kemo arbaa kosot. veyesh lo ligmor et hahallel bechol makom sheyyirtze af al pi sheeno mekom seeudda:

Makom shennahagu leechol tzali belele pesachim ochlim. makom shennahagu shello leechol en ochlin gezera shemma yomru besar pesach hu. uvechol makom asur leechol se tzaluy kullo keechad belayil ze mippene shennire keochel kadashim bachutz. veim haya mechuttach o shechaser mimmennu evar o shalak bo evar vehu mechubbar hare ze muttar bemakom shennahagu:

Mi sheen lo yayin belele happesach mekaddesh al happat kederech sheose beshabbat veose kol haddevarim al hasseder hazze. mi sheen lo yarak ella maror bilvad. battechilla mevarech al hammaror shete berachot bore peri haadama veal achilat maror veochel. uchesheyyigmor hahaggada mevarech al hammatztza veochel vechozer veochel min hammaror belo beracha:
Mi sheen lo matztza meshummeret ella kezayit kesheggomer seuddato mimmatztza sheenah meshummeret mevarech al achilat matztza veochel oto kezayit veeno toem acharav kelum:

Mi sheyyashan betoch hasseudda vehekitz eno chozer veochel. bene chavura sheyyashnu miktzatan betoch hasseudda chozrin veochlin. nirdemu kullan veneoru lo yochlu. nitnamnemu kullan yochlu: seliku lehu hilchot chametz umatza:
Nusach hahaggada shennahagu bah yisrael bizman haggalut kach hu, matchil al kos shene veomer:

Bivhilu yatzanu mimmitzrayim. ha lachma anya deachlu avahatana beara demitzrayim: kol dakepayn yete veyechul, kol detzarich lefesach yete vayyippaseach. shatta hacha, leshana habbaa beara deyisrael. shatta hada avde, leshitta deatya bene chore.

Ma nishtanna hallayla hazze mikkol hallelot! shebbechol hallelot en anu matbilin afillu paam achat, vehallayla hazze shete peamim. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlim chametz umitztza, vehallayla hazze kullo matztza. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlim shear yerakot, vehallayla hazze maror. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin ben yoshvin ben missubbin, vehallayla hazze kavelanev missubbin.

Avadim hayeynu lefaro bemitzrayim, vayyotzienu Adonai elohenu mishsham beyad chazaka uvizroa netuya. veillu lo hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu et avotenu mimmitzrayim, adayin anu uvaninu uvene banenu meshuebadim hayeynu lefaro bemitzrayim. vaafillu kavelanev chachamim, kavelanev nevonim, kavelanev zekenim, kavelanev yodim et hattora – mitzva alenu lispor bitziat mitzrayim. vechol hammaarich bitziat mitzrayim – hare ze meshubbach.

Maase berabbi eliezer, verabbi Yehoshua, verabbi elazar ben azarya, verabbi akeybeh, verabbi tarfon, shehayu missubbin bivne barak. vehayu masepareyn bitziat mitzrayim kol oto hallayla, ad shebbau talemaydayham veamro lahem: rabbotenu! higgia zeman keriat shema shel shacharit.

Amar lahem rabbi elazar ben azarya: hare ani keven shivim shana, velo zachiti shettomar yetziat mitzrayim ballelot, ad shedderashah ben zoma, shenneemar (Devarim 16:3): "lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha" – "yeme chayyecha" hayamim, "kol yeme chayyecha" hallelot. vachachamim omrim: "yeme chayyecha" haolam hazze, "kol yeme chayyecha" lehavi et yamut hammashiach.
